products.page_description: iPhone 17 Pro Max. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.9-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and best-ever battery life.

feature_entries.description: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks.² And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BEST BATTERY LIFE IN AN IPHONE EVER—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 39 hours of video playback.#&8308; Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.#&8309;

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7¹⁰, 5G networks¹¹, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹²

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 Pro Max activates with an eSIM¹². With eSIM, you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY— A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

products.page_description: Galaxy A17 5G delivers everything you need at an awesome price for an awesome value. Capture precious memories in vivid colors and clarity with its enhanced triple lens camera. Stream your favorite movies and shows on its crystal clear 6.7" display. Now with the power of AI, Galaxy A17 5G makes web searches that much easier to seamlessly plan events, make dinner reservations, find the perfect gifts for loved ones and more with the help of Gemini. Power through your day with a reliable Super Fast Charging battery, up to 2TB of expandable storage and ultra fast 5G to stay connected with loved ones. As a Galaxy owner, you'll have access to amazing perks like Samsung Wallet, Samsung TV Plus and more. And with OS and security updates, Galaxy A17 5G keeps you protected and up to date So bring home a phone that delivers incredible value and makes every day a little more awesome.

feature_entries.title: Your content, super smooth
feature_entries.description: The ultra clear 6.7” FHD+ Super AMOLED display¹ of Galaxy A17 5G helps bring your content to life, whether you’re scrolling through recipes or video chatting with loved ones.

feature_entries.title: Memories made picture perfect
feature_entries.description: Capture precious memories at family gatherings, graduations or life’s many milestones in vivid detail with Galaxy A17 5G. Even when your hands aren’t perfectly steady, you’ll find less blur in your pics with new Optical Image Stabilization. Take wide or intimate shots with stunning clarity thanks to the triple lens camera on A17 5G.

feature_entries.title: More durable than ever before
feature_entries.description: With an improved IP54 rating,² Galaxy A17 5G is even more durable than before. It’s built to resist splashes and dust and comes with a stronger yet slimmer Gorilla ® Glass Victus ® front and Glass Fiber Reinforced Polymer back, so you can worry less and do more.

feature_entries.title: Awesome price. Awesome value.
feature_entries.description: Get all you need at an awesome price with Galaxy A17 5G. Enjoy reliability with an advanced triple lens camera to capture precious moments clearly. Simplify your everyday with AI so you can focus more on family and friends. Find essential features like Samsung Wallet³ for secure payments and up to 2TB of expandable storage.⁴ Plus, with 6 OS and 6 years of software updates, you can take comfort knowing that your phone will remain secure and up to date.⁵

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy A17 5G. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of Tap to Pay⁶ with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung Knox technology.

feature_entries.title: 6 OS and 6 years of awesome security updates
feature_entries.description: Get more value from a phone that’s designed to go the distance inside and out. Galaxy A17 5G brings you 6 OS and 6 years of security updates, keeping your phone protected, efficient and up to date for much longer.⁵ Enjoy peace of mind with every update.

feature_entries.title: The best of TV. All for free. All on your phone.
feature_entries.description: Your Galaxy A17 5G comes with Samsung TV Plus all the entertainment you want at zero cost. Choose from 350+ live TV channels and thousands of movies and shows on demand, all for free.

feature_entries.title: Supercharge your day with Super Fast Charging
feature_entries.description: Focus more on the moment and less on your battery percentage with Galaxy A17 5G. Super Fast Charging⁷ powers up your battery so you can get back to life sooner.

feature_entries.title: Need more storage? We have you covered.
feature_entries.description: With an improved internal 2TB of expandable⁸ storage, Galaxy A17 5G makes it easy to keep cherished photos, videos and important files readily accessible whenever you need them.

feature_entries.title: Protect personal data with confidence
feature_entries.description: Securely protect your files and rest easy knowing your sensitive data is safeguarded with the fortified layers of Knox Security.⁹

feature_entries.title: Awesome AI for awesome living
feature_entries.description: Discover more about the things you see using Circle to Search¹⁰ on Galaxy A17 5G. Find a pair of shoes you like online? Simply circle them on your phone to find out the brand and where they’re available.

Galaxy A17 5G helps you keep up with life so you can enjoy it. Need to organize a gathering and let everyone in the family know? With simply one voice command, AI will search for group game ideas, put the event in your calendar, and text those you love with the details all without having to switch between apps.¹¹ Now that is awesome AI.

products.page_description: When everything just works, you stay in the moment. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra anticipates what you need next, empowers your creativity, delivers powerful performance with stunning, ultra-vivid viewing and even gives you the freedom to keep your screen private—whenever you choose. Out with friends and capturing the night? Nightography brings every scene to life, revealing rich detail even in low light. Snap photos or record video confidently as the night goes on, and then use Photo Assist with Galaxy AI to refine your shots in seconds —cleaning up distractions, enhancing details and helping every memory look the way it felt. No extra apps. No slowing down. Creativity doesn’t stop once the moment is captured. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI on Galaxy S26 Ultra turns inspiration into creation, just like that. Transform photos into custom stickers, design invitations or generate entirely new images using a simple prompt —all without switching apps or learning new tools. Whether you’re refining a memory or imagining something brand new, Galaxy AI helps bring ideas to life effortlessly, so creativity feels intuitive, not technical. When it’s time to turn ideas into plans, Galaxy S26 Ultra makes it simple. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI helps you stay on top of conversations by suggesting quick actions like adding an event, sharing a photo or finding a location —all without slowing things down. All of this happens with privacy in mind. With the world’s first privacy display built into a phone, you can keep personal moments for your eyes only. Whether you’re creating, checking emails or just catching up, everything feels effortless and on your terms. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is more than a smartphone —it’s your companion.

feature_entries.title: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone
feature_entries.description: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Clear when you look at it straight on but more private when others look in, Privacy Display can even be preset to automatically turn on when receiving notifications, typing in passwords or using specific apps.¹³

feature_entries.title: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.
feature_entries.description: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

feature_entries.title: Strong performance. Smooth play
feature_entries.description: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

feature_entries.title: Remove the mess. Restore the magic
feature_entries.description: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

feature_entries.title: Make it. Edit it. Share it.
feature_entries.description: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

feature_entries.title: Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.
feature_entries.description: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

feature_entries.title: Memorable nights, clearly captured
feature_entries.description: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. When you take photos or record videos, S26 automatically adjusts in real time to keep what you capture clear and bright so you never have to think about lighting or settings.

feature_entries.title: Richer color. Sharper detail.
feature_entries.description: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Charge fast. Move faster.
feature_entries.description: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy S25 FE 128GB (Unlocked) - Jet Black
products.description: Galaxy S25 FE brings upgraded essentials to level up your everyday. Its lightweight and sleek design makes it easy to carry; and wrapped in durable Gorilla Glass Victus+ and a sturdy Armor Aluminum frame, it’s built to go wherever life takes you. The 6.7" full HD display with barely there bezels gives you more room to see and do and ensures smooth scrolling with a refresh rate up to120Hz. Plus, S25 FE brings smart assistance to your everyday with Gemini Live. Show Gemini what you see with camera sharing, and ask questions in real time. Add to that an advanced camera. Whether you're snapping a quick selfie or editing vacation footage, S25 FE helps you get the shot and polish it too. The triple lens rear camera system captures every angle with clarity, and the 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine makes every shot count from bright daytime photos to clear low light moments. Plus, now you can erase audio, adjust skin tone, resize objects and more with AI powered Generative Edit. With a faster CPU, GPU and NPU, a larger vapor chamber for better cooling and a 4,900mAh battery with Super Fast Charging 2.0, Galaxy S25 FE delivers steady performance that carries you through your day. It’s the everyday ready device with smart, powerful, premium features that actually make a difference.

feature_entries.title: Big. Bright. Smooth.
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE makes room for more¹ of what you love with a 6.7” FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display² and slimmer bezels that expand your view. Whether you’re scrolling or streaming, a refresh rate of up to 120Hz keeps every movement smooth and seamless, while rich colors and crisp clarity pull you deeper into every scene.

feature_entries.title: Packed with strength, for your everyday
feature_entries.description: You shouldn’t have to treat your phone like it’s fragile. And with Galaxy S25 FE, you don’t have to. Its upgraded¹ Armor Aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ offer lasting durability, helping protect your device from the daily bumps and mishaps³ that come with life on the go.

feature_entries.title: Selfies that stun
feature_entries.description: Whether the sun’s shining or the stars are out, Galaxy S25 FE makes every moment share worthy. The 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine uses Super HDR and low noise modes⁴ to capture amazing portraits and next level selfies, day or night. Plus, you can now easily edit your videos with Audio Eraser⁵ to make sure your videos sound as good as they look.

feature_entries.title: Move it. Remove it. Improve it.
feature_entries.description: Take control of your photos like never before. With Generative Edit⁶ on Galaxy S25 FE, you can move, resize or erase anything in the frame no do over required. Want to remove a stranger in the background or reposition an object? With Galaxy AI it's easy to make your images look exactly as you imagined.

feature_entries.title: More power. Less plugging in
feature_entries.description: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25 FE. Built with a more powerful 4,900mAh battery,¹ it optimizes energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging. And when you do need to top it off, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁸ gets you back in action in no time.⁷

feature_entries.title: Show Gemini, get instant help
feature_entries.description: Sometimes it’s easier to show than explain.⁹ With your Galaxy S25 FE, share your camera while using Gemini Live, and your AI assistant can see what you see and respond in real time. Just point your camera and let Gemini Live offer up ideas, answers or suggestions based on what’s in the frame. From menu suggestions, to interpreting symbols on garments for special washing, it’s a smarter way to search that uses what you see.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight design, everyday ease
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE is lightweight and designed to keep up without weighing you down. Whether you’re tossing it in a bag, slipping it into your pocket or holding it in your palm, it’s easy to carry and hard to put down.

feature_entries.title: Powerful performance, now accessible
feature_entries.description: When your phone can think faster, everything else follows. Galaxy S25 FE is equipped with a premium processor that delivers faster CPU, GPU and NPU speeds. That means smoother multitasking, quicker reactions and a sustained performance through your day with its improved cooling system. It’s a serious upgrade that makes everyday feel effortless.¹

feature_entries.title: See it big. Hear it better.
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE and Buds3 FE¹⁰ are a match made in content heaven. With a wider display¹ and bold, balanced audio, your favorite shows, games and videos feel immersive from the first second. The expansive screen and powerful sound work together to turn screen time into an experience.

feature_entries.title: Talk to Gemini, hands free
feature_entries.description: Have your hands full? No problem. Access Gemini on your Galaxy phone hands free with Galaxy Buds3 FE,¹⁰ using your voice.¹¹ Whether you're mid commute or mid workout, get help with texts, reminders, directions and more, all without reaching for your phone.

feature_entries.title: Move between your Galaxy devices. Your Buds follow.
feature_entries.description: No need to dig through menus or re pair every time you change devices. Galaxy Buds3 FE pair by opening the cradle¹² and know exactly when to follow you from phone to Tab to PC.¹³ So whatever you're listening to, the switch is smooth and the connection is constant.

products.description: iPhone 15 brings you Dynamic Island, a 48MP Main camera, and USB-C—all in a durable color-infused glass and aluminum design.
products.page_description: iPhone 15 brings you Dynamic Island, a 48MP Main camera, and USB-C—all in a durable color-infused glass and aluminum design.

feature_entries.description: DYNAMIC ISLAND COMES TO IPHONE 15 — Dynamic Island bubbles up alerts and Live Activities — so you don’t miss them while you’re doing something else. You can see who’s calling, track your next ride, check your flight status, and so much more.

INNOVATIVE DESIGN — iPhone 15 features a durable color-infused glass and aluminum design. It’s splash, water, and dust resistant.¹ The Ceramic Shield front is tougher than any smartphone glass. And the 6.1" Super Retina XDR display² is up to 2x brighter in the sun compared to iPhone 14.

48MP MAIN CAMERA WITH 2X TELEPHOTO — The 48MP Main camera shoots in super high-resolution. So it’s easier than ever to take standout photos with amazing detail. The 2x optical-quality Telephoto lets you frame the perfect close-up.
NEXT-GENERATION PORTRAITS — Capture portraits with dramatically more detail and color. Just tap to shift the focus between subjects — even after you take the shot.

POWERHOUSE A16 BIONIC CHIP — The superfast chip powers advanced features like computational photography, fluid Dynamic Island transitions, and Voice Isolation for phone calls. And A16 Bionic is incredibly efficient to help deliver great all-day battery life.³
USB-C CONNECTIVITY — The USB-C connector lets you charge your Mac or iPad with the same cable you use to charge iPhone 15. You can even use iPhone 15 to charge Apple Watch or AirPods.

VITAL SAFETY FEATURES — If your car breaks down when you’re off the grid, you can get help with Roadside Assistance via satellite.⁴ And if you need emergency services and you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, you can use Emergency SOS via satellite.⁴
With Crash Detection, iPhone can detect a severe car crash and call for help if you can’t.⁵

DESIGNED TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE — iPhone comes with privacy protections that help keep you in control of your data. It’s made from more recycled materials to minimize environmental impact. And it has built-in features that make iPhone more accessible to all.

COMES WITH APPLECARE WARRANTY — Every iPhone comes with a one-year limited warranty and up to 90 days of complimentary technical support. Get AppleCare+ or AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss to extend your coverage.

¹iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 15 Pro, and iPhone 15 Pro Max are splash, water, and dust resistant and were tested under controlled laboratory conditions with a rating of IP68 under IEC standard 60529 (maximum depth of 6 meters up to 30 minutes).

Splash, water, and dust resistance are not permanent conditions. Resistance might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge a wet iPhone; refer to the user guide for cleaning and drying instructions. Liquid damage not covered under warranty.

²The display has rounded corners. When measured as a standard rectangle, the screen is 6.12 inches (iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15) or 6.69 inches (iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Plus) diagonally. Actual viewable area is less.
³Battery life varies by use and configuration; see apple.com/batteries for more information.

⁴Service is included for free for two years with the activation of any iPhone 15 model. Connection and response times vary based on location, site conditions, and other factors. See support.apple.com/kb/HT213885 for more information.
⁵iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Pro can detect a severe car crash and call for help. Requires a cellular connection or Wi-Fi Calling.
Accessories are sold separately

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy S26 Ultra 512GB (Unlocked) - Black
products.description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra 512GB (Unlocked) with Black
products.page_description: When everything just works, you stay in the moment. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra anticipates what you need next, empowers your creativity, delivers powerful performance with stunning, ultra-vivid viewing and even gives you the freedom to keep your screen private—whenever you choose. Out with friends and capturing the night? Nightography brings every scene to life, revealing rich detail even in low light. Snap photos or record video confidently as the night goes on, and then use Photo Assist with Galaxy AI to refine your shots in seconds —cleaning up distractions, enhancing details and helping every memory look the way it felt. No extra apps. No slowing down. Creativity doesn’t stop once the moment is captured. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI on Galaxy S26 Ultra turns inspiration into creation, just like that. Transform photos into custom stickers, design invitations or generate entirely new images using a simple prompt —all without switching apps or learning new tools. Whether you’re refining a memory or imagining something brand new, Galaxy AI helps bring ideas to life effortlessly, so creativity feels intuitive, not technical. When it’s time to turn ideas into plans, Galaxy S26 Ultra makes it simple. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI helps you stay on top of conversations by suggesting quick actions like adding an event, sharing a photo or finding a location —all without slowing things down. All of this happens with privacy in mind. With the world’s first privacy display built into a phone, you can keep personal moments for your eyes only. Whether you’re creating, checking emails or just catching up, everything feels effortless and on your terms. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is more than a smartphone —it’s your companion.

feature_entries.title: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone
feature_entries.description: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Clear when you look at it straight on but more private when others look in, Privacy Display can even be preset to automatically turn on when receiving notifications, typing in passwords or using specific apps.¹³

feature_entries.title: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.
feature_entries.description: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

feature_entries.title: Strong performance. Smooth play
feature_entries.description: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

feature_entries.title: Remove the mess. Restore the magic
feature_entries.description: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

feature_entries.title: Make it. Edit it. Share it.
feature_entries.description: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

feature_entries.title: Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.
feature_entries.description: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

feature_entries.title: Memorable nights, clearly captured
feature_entries.description: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. When you take photos or record videos, S26 automatically adjusts in real time to keep what you capture clear and bright so you never have to think about lighting or settings.

feature_entries.title: Richer color. Sharper detail.
feature_entries.description: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Charge fast. Move faster.
feature_entries.description: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.; Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.; Charge fast. Move faster.: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴; Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. feature_entries.title: Universal Unlocked
feature_entries.description: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, and Mint.

feature_entries.title: The power behind AI on Google Pixel
feature_entries.description: Google Tensor G4 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It’s built for advanced AI like Gemini, cutting-edge photos and videos, and smarter ways to help all day.¹

feature_entries.title: Gemini. Your built-in AI assistant
feature_entries.description: Gemini helps you supercharge your ideas. Hold the power button to start writing, planning, learning, and more.²

feature_entries.title: Advanced camera. Next-level amazing
feature_entries.description: The award-winning Pixel Camera includes a 50 MP main sensor for incredible image and video quality. And a new 48 MP ultrawide camera for stunning Macro Focus.

feature_entries.title: Pixel helps keep your info safe.
feature_entries.description: Pixel 9 phones have multiple layers of hardware security to help keep you and personal information safe. Pixel 9 phones were recently recognized as the highest-rated for security when tested among other smartphones by a third-party global research firm.

feature_entries.title: The amazing Actua display
feature_entries.description: The 6.3-inch Actua display is sharp, vibrant, and super bright.³ It runs fast, up to 120Hz, for smooth gaming, scrolling, and switching between apps.⁴

feature_entries.title: Powerful performance
feature_entries.description: Pixel 9 runs fast and smooth with 12 GB of RAM. And it’s designed to handle Google’s advanced AI.

feature_entries.title: Super fast charging, all-day battery
feature_entries.description: The Pixel 9 battery can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.⁵ And it can charge to 55% in about 30 minutes.⁶

feature_entries.title: Give photos a whole new vision
feature_entries.description: Reimagine photos in Magic Editor, like adding fall leaves or green grass. Just tap what part you want to change in the photo, and type what you want to see.⁷

feature_entries.title: It’s built to last
feature_entries.description: Pixel can handle everyday drops, spills, and dust.⁸ And the display is scratch and damage resistant, made with Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2.⁸

feature_entries.title: Take the picture. And be in it, too
feature_entries.description: Add Me makes sure no one is left out of a photo. Take one with the group, then swap in the photographer. Pixel magically merges both photos.⁷

feature_entries.title: Turn up sound. Turn down noise
feature_entries.description: Use Audio Magic Eraser to reduce distracting noise in video, like music and wind. And turn up the sounds you want.⁹

feature_entries.title: Fast help in an emergency
feature_entries.description: If you’re in an emergency, press the power button 5 times. Pixel can call emergency services and share your location with contacts.⁰

feature_entries.title: Goodbye, spam calls. Pixel helps you avoid unwanted calls
feature_entries.description: Call Screen on Pixel can detect and filter out spam calls.1 If it’s not spam, Pixel can let you know who’s calling and why.¹¹

feature_entries.title: Pixel Drops make your phone feel new
feature_entries.description: Your Pixel gets a boost of helpfulness with automatic Pixel Drops.12 They include new camera features, helpful tools, and more. So your Pixel keeps getting better over time.

feature_entries.title: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone
feature_entries.description: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Clear when you look at it straight on but more private when others look in, Privacy Display can even be preset to automatically turn on when receiving notifications, typing in passwords or using specific apps.¹³

feature_entries.title: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.
feature_entries.description: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

feature_entries.title: Strong performance. Smooth play
feature_entries.description: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

feature_entries.title: Remove the mess. Restore the magic
feature_entries.description: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

feature_entries.title: Make it. Edit it. Share it.
feature_entries.description: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

feature_entries.title: Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.
feature_entries.description: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

feature_entries.title: Memorable nights, clearly captured
feature_entries.description: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. When you take photos or record videos, S26 automatically adjusts in real time to keep what you capture clear and bright so you never have to think about lighting or settings.

feature_entries.title: Richer color. Sharper detail.
feature_entries.description: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Charge fast. Move faster.
feature_entries.description: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy S25 FE 256GB (Unlocked) - Jet Black
products.description: Galaxy S25 FE brings upgraded essentials to level up your everyday. Its lightweight and sleek design makes it easy to carry; and wrapped in durable Gorilla Glass Victus+ and a sturdy Armor Aluminum frame, it’s built to go wherever life takes you. The 6.7" full HD display with barely there bezels gives you more room to see and do and ensures smooth scrolling with a refresh rate up to120Hz. Plus, S25 FE brings smart assistance to your everyday with Gemini Live. Show Gemini what you see with camera sharing, and ask questions in real time. Add to that an advanced camera. Whether you're snapping a quick selfie or editing vacation footage, S25 FE helps you get the shot and polish it too. The triple lens rear camera system captures every angle with clarity, and the 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine makes every shot count from bright daytime photos to clear low light moments. Plus, now you can erase audio, adjust skin tone, resize objects and more with AI powered Generative Edit. With a faster CPU, GPU and NPU, a larger vapor chamber for better cooling and a 4,900mAh battery with Super Fast Charging 2.0, Galaxy S25 FE delivers steady performance that carries you through your day. It’s the everyday ready device with smart, powerful, premium features that actually make a difference.

feature_entries.title: Big. Bright. Smooth.
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE makes room for more¹ of what you love with a 6.7” FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display² and slimmer bezels that expand your view. Whether you’re scrolling or streaming, a refresh rate of up to 120Hz keeps every movement smooth and seamless, while rich colors and crisp clarity pull you deeper into every scene.

feature_entries.title: Packed with strength, for your everyday
feature_entries.description: You shouldn’t have to treat your phone like it’s fragile. And with Galaxy S25 FE, you don’t have to. Its upgraded¹ Armor Aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ offer lasting durability, helping protect your device from the daily bumps and mishaps³ that come with life on the go.

feature_entries.title: Selfies that stun
feature_entries.description: Whether the sun’s shining or the stars are out, Galaxy S25 FE makes every moment share worthy. The 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine uses Super HDR and low noise modes⁴ to capture amazing portraits and next level selfies, day or night. Plus, you can now easily edit your videos with Audio Eraser⁵ to make sure your videos sound as good as they look.

feature_entries.title: Move it. Remove it. Improve it.
feature_entries.description: Take control of your photos like never before. With Generative Edit⁶ on Galaxy S25 FE, you can move, resize or erase anything in the frame no do over required. Want to remove a stranger in the background or reposition an object? With Galaxy AI it's easy to make your images look exactly as you imagined.

feature_entries.title: More power. Less plugging in
feature_entries.description: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25 FE. Built with a more powerful 4,900mAh battery,¹ it optimizes energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging. And when you do need to top it off, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁸ gets you back in action in no time.⁷

feature_entries.title: Show Gemini, get instant help
feature_entries.description: Sometimes it’s easier to show than explain.⁹ With your Galaxy S25 FE, share your camera while using Gemini Live, and your AI assistant can see what you see and respond in real time. Just point your camera and let Gemini Live offer up ideas, answers or suggestions based on what’s in the frame. From menu suggestions, to interpreting symbols on garments for special washing, it’s a smarter way to search that uses what you see.

feature_entries.title: Lightweight design, everyday ease
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE is lightweight and designed to keep up without weighing you down. Whether you’re tossing it in a bag, slipping it into your pocket or holding it in your palm, it’s easy to carry and hard to put down.

feature_entries.title: Powerful performance, now accessible
feature_entries.description: When your phone can think faster, everything else follows. Galaxy S25 FE is equipped with a premium processor that delivers faster CPU, GPU and NPU speeds. That means smoother multitasking, quicker reactions and a sustained performance through your day with its improved cooling system. It’s a serious upgrade that makes everyday feel effortless.¹

feature_entries.title: See it big. Hear it better.
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 FE and Buds3 FE¹⁰ are a match made in content heaven. With a wider display¹ and bold, balanced audio, your favorite shows, games and videos feel immersive from the first second. The expansive screen and powerful sound work together to turn screen time into an experience.

feature_entries.title: Talk to Gemini, hands free
feature_entries.description: Have your hands full? No problem. Access Gemini on your Galaxy phone hands free with Galaxy Buds3 FE,¹⁰ using your voice.¹¹ Whether you're mid commute or mid workout, get help with texts, reminders, directions and more, all without reaching for your phone.

feature_entries.title: Move between your Galaxy devices. Your Buds follow.
feature_entries.description: No need to dig through menus or re pair every time you change devices. Galaxy Buds3 FE pair by opening the cradle¹² and know exactly when to follow you from phone to Tab to PC.¹³ So whatever you're listening to, the switch is smooth and the connection is constant.

products.page_description: Meet Google Pixel 10a. Brilliant photography, helpful AI,¹ and a durable design.² It’s got all the essentials, plus features you’ll love.

feature_entries.title: Universal Unlocked
feature_entries.description: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Visible, Google Fi, Mint, Tracfone, MetroPCS, Total Wireless, and Cricket Wireless.

feature_entries.title: Take extraordinary photos every day
feature_entries.description: Capture crisp details up close and in low light with the amazing features of the Google Pixel 10a camera. Snap beautiful shots easily, get everyone into the group pic, and take photos where everyone looks their best.⁴

feature_entries.title: Lasts for years and years
feature_entries.description: A battery that lasts for 30+ hours,³ 7 years of updates,⁰ and a durable design make Google Pixel 10a perfect for wherever life takes you.²

feature_entries.title: More time for you. That’s why Google AI
feature_entries.description: Google AI handles the details so you can get back to what’s important. Have it screen spam calls while you focus.⁵ Chat with Gemini to brainstorm your weekly meal plan,¹ or see what your selfie would look like in another decade with Nano Banana.⁶

feature_entries.title: Goodbye, spam calls
feature_entries.description: Call Screen on Pixel can detect and filter out spam calls. If it’s not spam, Pixel can let you know who’s calling and why.⁵

feature_entries.title: Pixel helps protect you and your sensitive info
feature_entries.description: With real-time security checks, Pixel gives you continuous protection online,⁷ proactive spam alerts,⁷ and a way to connect with emergency services, even off the grid.⁸,⁹

feature_entries.title: Stop settling. Make the switch
feature_entries.description: Google makes switching simple, from transferring data like your iMessages and photos, to getting started with Pixel features. You can even transfer your eSIM so you can start using your Google Pixel and all it has to offer right away – like innovative AI that helps you take stunning photos and videos, get more done, and keep your info safe. (iMessage® is a registered trademark of Apple Inc.)

feature_entries.title: The group chat that acts like one
feature_entries.description: Now you can share high-quality images and text reactions, get read receipts, and more, making your group chats work the way they should.

feature_entries.title: A great phone for the whole family
feature_entries.description: Google Pixel 10a is tough enough for everyday drops, and its family settings make it easy for you and your kids to stay on the same page.

products.page_description: iPhone 17. More delightful. More durable. 6.3-inch ProMotion display, Ceramic Shield 2, all 48MP rear cameras, Center Stage front camera, A19 chip, and more.

feature_entries.description: DESIGNED TO DELIGHT. BUILT TO LAST.—iPhone 17 comes in five gorgeous colors, with a brighter 6.3-inch display¹, and a Ceramic Shield 2 front that’s 3x more scratch resistant.²
6.3-INCH DISPLAY WITH PROMOTION. BRIGHTER. BRILLIANT.—Smooth scrolling with ProMotion up to 120Hz, better outdoor contrast with 3000 nits peak brightness, and 33% fewer reflections.¹
STUNNING SHOTS—Capture super-high-resolution shots by default with the advanced 48MP Dual Fusion camera system, 2x optical-quality zoom, and 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide camera.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA—Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 CHIP. POWER PLAYER. ENERGY EXPERT.—With a 5-core GPU, the enhanced neural engine helps power everything you to do on iPhone—from Apple Intelligence³ to AAA games.
CHARGES FAST. MAKES IT LAST.—All-day battery life with up to 30 hours of video playback.⁴ Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.⁵

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.³

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁷ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁸
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7⁹, 5G networks¹⁰, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹¹

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 activates with an eSIM. With eSIM¹¹, you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY—A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

products.page_description: Meet Pixel 10 Pro, the new standard for pro phones. Advanced AI with Gemini, unbelievable camera quality, impeccable design, and the next-gen Google Tensor G5 chip.¹

feature_entries.title: Universal Unlocked
feature_entries.description: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

feature_entries.title: The power behind AI on Google Pixel
feature_entries.description: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

feature_entries.title: Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine
feature_entries.description: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

feature_entries.title: You show, Gemini tells
feature_entries.description: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

feature_entries.title: Picture yourself anywhere
feature_entries.description: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

feature_entries.title: Set your creative ideas in motion
feature_entries.description: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.⁶

feature_entries.title: 16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance
feature_entries.description: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

feature_entries.title: The brightest display ever on a Pixel
feature_entries.description: See your phone in a whole new light with 3,300-nit peak brightness.⁴ The new Super Actua display makes your screen look immersive and vibrant, even in direct sunlight. And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

feature_entries.title: Fast-charging, all-day battery
feature_entries.description: Pixel 10 Pro XL has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

feature_entries.title: Studio-quality photos. Pro-level videos
feature_entries.description: Pixel’s pro camera system makes everything look amazing by default, even in low light. Capture more of the scene with advanced AI models, and bring out incredible details with up to 100x zoom, stunning 50 MP images, and super steady videos in 8K with Video Boost.⁵

feature_entries.title: Amazing selfies of you, and everyone else
feature_entries.description: The 42 MP front camera with autofocus features a 103° field of view – Pixel’s widest, most selfie-ready yet.⁵ You and the whole group come out remarkably sharp in photos or videos, even in dimly lit situations like restaurants and concerts.

feature_entries.title: Take the picture. And be in it, too
feature_entries.description: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

feature_entries.title: Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini
feature_entries.description: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

feature_entries.title: Group pics the whole group loves
feature_entries.description: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.

feature_entries.title: Up to 20x the video zoom power
feature_entries.description: Pixel 10 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens for up to 20x zoom with Super Res Zoom Video and advanced processing to give you smooth, high-quality video.

feature_entries.title: Low-light videos get a glow-up
feature_entries.description: Night Sight Video with Video Boost brings out the highest-quality 8K recordings on a Pixel for even richer scenes of sunset skylines and candlelit dinners.

feature_entries.title: Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords
feature_entries.description: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

products.page_description: Meet Pixel 10 Pro, the new standard for pro phones. Advanced AI with Gemini, unbelievable camera quality, impeccable design, and the next-gen Google Tensor G5 chip.¹

feature_entries.title: Universal Unlocked
feature_entries.description: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

feature_entries.title: The power behind AI on Google Pixel
feature_entries.description: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

feature_entries.title: Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine
feature_entries.description: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

feature_entries.title: You show, Gemini tells
feature_entries.description: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

feature_entries.title: Picture yourself anywhere
feature_entries.description: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

feature_entries.title: Set your creative ideas in motion
feature_entries.description: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.⁶

feature_entries.title: 16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance
feature_entries.description: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

feature_entries.title: The brightest display ever on a Pixel
feature_entries.description: See your phone in a whole new light with 3,300-nit peak brightness.⁴ The new Super Actua display makes your screen look immersive and vibrant, even in direct sunlight. And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

feature_entries.title: Fast-charging, all-day battery
feature_entries.description: Pixel 10 Pro XL has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

feature_entries.title: Studio-quality photos. Pro-level videos
feature_entries.description: Pixel’s pro camera system makes everything look amazing by default, even in low light. Capture more of the scene with advanced AI models, and bring out incredible details with up to 100x zoom, stunning 50 MP images, and super steady videos in 8K with Video Boost.⁵

feature_entries.title: Amazing selfies of you, and everyone else
feature_entries.description: The 42 MP front camera with autofocus features a 103° field of view – Pixel’s widest, most selfie-ready yet.⁵ You and the whole group come out remarkably sharp in photos or videos, even in dimly lit situations like restaurants and concerts.

feature_entries.title: Take the picture. And be in it, too
feature_entries.description: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

feature_entries.title: Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini
feature_entries.description: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

feature_entries.title: Group pics the whole group loves
feature_entries.description: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.

feature_entries.title: Up to 20x the video zoom power
feature_entries.description: Pixel 10 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens for up to 20x zoom with Super Res Zoom Video and advanced processing to give you smooth, high-quality video.

feature_entries.title: Low-light videos get a glow-up
feature_entries.description: Night Sight Video with Video Boost brings out the highest-quality 8K recordings on a Pixel for even richer scenes of sunset skylines and candlelit dinners.

feature_entries.title: Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords
feature_entries.description: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

products.page_description: Staying in the moment is easier than ever with the all-new Galaxy S25 Ultra. Its intelligent AI transforms into your own virtual assistant that evolves with you to work better for you. Let’s say you want to enjoy a night out with friends but don’t have time to plan. Just ask Galaxy S25 Ultra to invite your friends to the nearest bowling lounge tonight. Your phone will find the info and text it to them. You don’t need to slow down your speech or speak like a robot —just talk to your phone naturally, and it will understand. While you’re out rolling spares, Night Video brings out the details in every moment —even in low light —while Audio Eraser makes it easy to reduce distracting noises, like those pins crashing one lane over. Galaxy S25 Ultra also keeps up with your schedule and provides the weather forecast for your night, allowing you to stay a step ahead and adjust plans on the fly. With a phone as evolved as Galaxy S25 Ultra, you don’t have to sweat the small stuff —it’s handled intelligently.

feature_entries.title: Multiple tasks with one ask
feature_entries.description: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever before. Have it Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend. Ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Free up more time to do the things you love with a phone that handles multiple tasks with one simple command.¹

feature_entries.title: Insights that keep you a step ahead
feature_entries.description: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it. Galaxy S25 Ultra gives you personalized insights based on your schedule. For example, if it’s going to rain, your phone will remind you to grab an umbrella before heading out.²

feature_entries.title: Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic
feature_entries.description: With Galaxy S25 Ultra, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³

feature_entries.title: Bring out the best in every face
feature_entries.description: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on Galaxy S25 Ultra. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.

feature_entries.title: More power to you
feature_entries.description: The upgraded processor on Galaxy S25 Ultra handles complex AI features effortlessly.

feature_entries.title: Your images, clearer than ever
feature_entries.description: Your images feel life like on Galaxy S25 Ultra thanks to a brilliant display with ProScaler. Enjoy sharper visuals and brighter colors on a screen that makes details pop.⁴

feature_entries.title: One simple number. A world of insights.
feature_entries.description: Start your day in the know using Energy Score with Galaxy AI. It’s a daily score based off yesterday’s sleep, activity and heart rate, all collected by your Galaxy Ring or Watch. Then go deeper and discover insights for how to improve it on your Galaxy S25 Ultra device.⁵

feature_entries.title: Track your sleep from your wrist to your phone
feature_entries.description: Get an edge on your competition when you learn better sleep habits with the help of Galaxy AI. Track your sleep with your Galaxy Watch Ultra, and then get in-depth personalized tips on your Galaxy S25 Ultra device to put you on a path to feeling well rested.⁵

feature_entries.title: Stay up to date while your screen stays locked
feature_entries.description: Stay in the know on the go with Now Bar. It provides really quick updates, right on the lock screen of your Galaxy S25 Ultra device. Customize what you want to see —from your team’s latest score on Google Sports to your Energy Score on Samsung Health —then see it at a glance on your Now Bar. It even seamlessly connects with the all-new Now Brief so you can conveniently get helpful tips throughout your day.⁶

feature_entries.title: Stay charged. And in charge.
feature_entries.description: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25 Ultra. Built with long-lasting batteries, these phones optimize energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging.⁷ Also, charge your phone from 0% to 65% in just 30 minutes.⁹

feature_entries.title: Boost your gameplay with a boss-level battery
feature_entries.description: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy S25 Ultra is the ultimate boost for on-the-go gaming. It’s engineered to use energy efficiently so you can complete entire quests, compete in rounds of online tournaments and run circles around your rivals without worrying about your phone running on empty.

feature_entries.title: Clearly capture the complete picture
feature_entries.description: No need to step back. Stay where you are and snap the entire scene in full detail with the 50MP Ultra Wide lens on Galaxy S25 Ultra.

feature_entries.title: A shortcut to your favorite AI tools
feature_entries.description: With AI Select on Galaxy S25 Ultra, you’ve got easy access to powerful tools that help you do more with just about anything you see on your screen. Say you’ve found a piece of text or an image you like, take a screenshot and then access AI Select. Your phone uses AI to analyze your selection and then offers you a variety of tools you can use to take that piece of content even further.

feature_entries.title: Redesigned from the inside out
feature_entries.description: Galaxy S25 Ultra redefines the way you interact with your phone. Its ergonomic design features smoother edges and a comfortable grip for effortless handling, while the redesigned One UI 7 streamlines every task. Whether you’re enjoying long gaming sessions or navigating Galaxy AI tools, Galaxy S25 Ultra feels as good as it performs.

feature_entries.title: Switching is quick and easy
feature_entries.description: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S25 Ultra. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of tap to pay with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung’s Knox technology.⁸

feature_entries.title: Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine

feature_entries.description: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

products.page_description: Samsung Galaxy S26 keeps things moving effortlessly. From quick replies to creative moments, everything feels smooth and responsive as you move between texting, scrolling, creating and sharing with Galaxy AI. Even better, this seamless experience comes alive on a larger, vibrant display that automatically enriches color to make photos feel more expressive and videos more engaging. When inspiration strikes, it’s easy to act on it. Photo Assist with Galaxy AI helps you clean up a photo by removing distractions while restoring details or exploring artistic styles like painting, black and white or playful illustrations to give your photos an entirely new look. And when you want to do more, Creative Studio makes it simple to create custom stickers, personalize profile pictures or generate new images from a quick prompt. No extra apps. No technical skills. Just effortless tools that help turn ideas into something uniquely yours. Samsung Galaxy S26 brings performance, immersion and creativity together — designed to keep everything you do feeling fast, vivid and inspired.

feature_entries.title: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.
feature_entries.description: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

feature_entries.title: Strong performance. Smooth play
feature_entries.description: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

feature_entries.title: Remove the mess. Restore the magic
feature_entries.description: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

feature_entries.title: Make it. Edit it. Share it.
feature_entries.description: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

feature_entries.title: Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.
feature_entries.description: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

feature_entries.title: Richer color. Sharper wins.
feature_entries.description: Discover the immensely immersive display on Galaxy S26. With a screen that automatically enriches colors, you can catch all the little things you’ve been missing. And with a screen this vibrant, you can go beyond just watching your favorite videos and socials to feeling like you’re a part of them.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy S26 Ultra 1TB (Unlocked) - Black
products.description: When everything just works, you stay in the moment. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra anticipates what you need next, empowers your creativity, delivers powerful performance with stunning, ultra-vivid viewing and even gives you the freedom to keep your screen private—whenever you choose. Out with friends and capturing the night? Nightography brings every scene to life, revealing rich detail even in low light. Snap photos or record video confidently as the night goes on, and then use Photo Assist with Galaxy AI to refine your shots in seconds —cleaning up distractions, enhancing details and helping every memory look the way it felt. No extra apps. No slowing down. Creativity doesn’t stop once the moment is captured. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI on Galaxy S26 Ultra turns inspiration into creation, just like that. Transform photos into custom stickers, design invitations or generate entirely new images using a simple prompt —all without switching apps or learning new tools. Whether you’re refining a memory or imagining something brand new, Galaxy AI helps bring ideas to life effortlessly, so creativity feels intuitive, not technical. When it’s time to turn ideas into plans, Galaxy S26 Ultra makes it simple. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI helps you stay on top of conversations by suggesting quick actions like adding an event, sharing a photo or finding a location —all without slowing things down. All of this happens with privacy in mind. With the world’s first privacy display built into a phone, you can keep personal moments for your eyes only. Whether you’re creating, checking emails or just catching up, everything feels effortless and on your terms. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is more than a smartphone —it’s your companion.

feature_entries.title: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone
feature_entries.description: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Clear when you look at it straight on but more private when others look in, Privacy Display can even be preset to automatically turn on when receiving notifications, typing in passwords or using specific apps.¹³

feature_entries.title: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.
feature_entries.description: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

feature_entries.title: Strong performance. Smooth play
feature_entries.description: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

feature_entries.title: Remove the mess. Restore the magic
feature_entries.description: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

feature_entries.title: Make it. Edit it. Share it.
feature_entries.description: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

feature_entries.title: Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.
feature_entries.description: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

feature_entries.title: Memorable nights, clearly captured
feature_entries.description: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. When you take photos or record videos, S26 automatically adjusts in real time to keep what you capture clear and bright so you never have to think about lighting or settings.

feature_entries.title: Richer color. Sharper detail.
feature_entries.description: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Charge fast. Move faster.
feature_entries.description: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.
