products.description: iPhone 16. Built for Apple Intelligence. Featuring Camera Control. 48MP Fusion camera. Five vibrant colors. And A18 chip.
products.page_description: iPhone 16. Built for Apple Intelligence. Featuring Camera Control. 48MP Fusion camera. Five vibrant colors. And A18 chip.

feature_entries.description: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.¹ With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data.
TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL—Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.

GET FURTHER AND CLOSER—The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you takes incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES—The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles anytime you want.

SUPERSMART A18 CHIP—A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

LONGER BATTERY LIFE—iPhone 16 works together with the A18 chip to deliver a big boost in battery life with up to 22 hours video playback.² Charge via USB-C or snap on a MagSafe charger for faster wireless charging.³

DESIGNED TO LAST—iPhone 16 has a sturdy, aerospace-grade aluminum design with a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display.⁴ It’s remarkably durable with the latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s 2x tougher than any smartphone glass.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR IPHONE—With iOS 18 you can tint your Home Screen icons with any color. Find your favorite shots faster in the redesigned Photos app. And add playful, animated effects to any word, phrase, or emoji in iMessage.ⁱ

SATELLITE CONNECTIVITY—If you don't have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁶ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can't.⁷

products.title: Samsung - Refurbished Excellent - Galaxy S23 128GB (Unlocked) - Phantom Black
products.description: Galaxy AI is here. Search like never before,¹ get real-time interpretation on a call,² format your notes into a clear summary,³ and effortlessly edit your photos⁴ - all from your smartphone, all with AI. Meet Galaxy S23, the phone takes you out of the everyday and into the epic. Life doesn’t wait for the perfect lighting, but with Nightography, you are always ready to seize the moment and snap memories like a pro. See your content no matter the time of day on a display with a refresh rate up to 120Hz and Adaptive Vision Booster. Capture and create in rich detail, and then use Quick Share to share across devices without losing quality. Move past the mundane and embrace epic power with Galaxy S23.

source_listing.title: Samsung - Refurbished Excellent - Galaxy S23 128GB (Unlocked) - Phantom Black

products.page_description: Refurbished Excellent

feature_entries.title: Circle it, search it,¹ find it. Just like that.
feature_entries.description: What’s your favorite influencer wearing? Where’d they go on vacation? What’s that word mean? Don’t try to describe it use Circle to Search with Google¹ and get the answer in a snap. Simply circle it on your screen to learn more.

feature_entries.title: Break down barriers to language barriers
feature_entries.description: Speak foreign languages on the spot with AI-powered Live Translate.² Unlock the power of convenient communication with near-real-time voice translations right through your Samsung Phone app.

feature_entries.title: Take a great photo. Then make it better.
feature_entries.description: Turn every photo into a post-worthy masterpiece with Galaxy AI. Move or remove objects. Fill in empty space. Simply snap a pic, and then take it from great to jaw-dropping with Generative Edit³

feature_entries.title: Be lost in conversation, not translation.
feature_entries.description: Wish you always had an interpreter on hand? Now you do with Galaxy AI. Simply hold up your phone during face-to-face conversations and receive real-time translations.⁴

feature_entries.title: Capture the night, even in low light
feature_entries.description: Ready to own the night? Whether you’re headed to a concert or romantic night out, there’s no such thing as bad lighting with Night Mode. Galaxy S23 lets you capture epic content in any setting with stunning Nightography.

feature_entries.title: Capture. Share. Impress.
feature_entries.description: Create crystal-clear content worth sharing with the 50MP high-resolution camera of Galaxy S23. Whether you’re posting or printing, Galaxy S23 always does the moment justice.

feature_entries.title: Our fastest mobile processor available
feature_entries.description: Whether you’re working hard, playing hard or doing both at the same time, smoothly switch between apps with our fastest processor ever.

feature_entries.title: The power to keep going
feature_entries.description: Whether you’re capturing a memory or catching up with friends, Galaxy S23 will be ready when you need it most. With a 3,900mAh battery, stay in the moment without worrying about your phone dying.¹

feature_entries.title: More storage. More memories.
feature_entries.description: Save life’s memories with 128GB or 256GB of storage. Whether you’re the family shutterbug or you carefully curate your gallery, capture the moment with confidence knowing that you have the right amount of space for your needs.

feature_entries.title: Watch anything in any light
feature_entries.description: Watch your content comfortably as Adaptive Vision Booster helps your screen adapt to your environment. Whether out in direct sunlight or in bed with the lights off, the contrast on Galaxy S23 expansive screen still looks amazing.

feature_entries.title: Convenient collaboration
feature_entries.description: Keep your group conversations going wherever you are with Galaxy S23 and Google Meet. Whether you’re having a video meeting with your team or your friends, use Google Meet to start a video chat on your Tab and then continue the call on your phone as you head out the door.⁶

feature_entries.title: Love it? Share it.
feature_entries.description: Send even your large files —whether it’s cute puppy videos or work documents —between your Galaxy S23 and any iOS or Android device. Quick Share helps minimize frustration when sharing the epic.⁷

feature_entries.title: Snap once. Capture a ton.
feature_entries.description: Get the group together for one shot and capture a variety of candid moments. Simply tap, record and choose from multiple stills and videos.⁸

feature_entries.title: Capture memories in stunning 8K Video
feature_entries.description: Capture memories in stunning detail with 8K Video recording. No matter the moment, Galaxy S23 lets you shoot ultra-bright, crystal-clear scenes —day or night.

feature_entries.title: Get back to on the go
feature_entries.description: Life’s best moments could happen at any second. With a battery that supports up to 25W Super-Fast Charging, it’s easy to stay ready. Power up your Galaxy S23 quickly and get back to making more memories.⁹

feature_entries.title: Tough when it matters most
feature_entries.description: Confidently take on whatever your day brings with Galaxy S23 —fortified with our toughest glass and metal frame available. Wave goodbye to worry with Gorilla Glass 8 and Armor Aluminum, built to resist scratches and spills.
Enjoy peace of mind as you cruise through life’s adventures with a phone as strong as it is stylish.

feature_entries.title: Your phone. Your look. Your style.
feature_entries.description: Design your own Galaxy experience with Galaxy S23. With our versatile One UI, you can personalize a lock screen that reflects your lifestyle.

feature_entries.title: Designed with our planet in mind
feature_entries.description: Feel good knowing your new phone supports what you support. Galaxy Galaxy S23 was designed to help you live in a more sustainable world, while enjoying everything that makes that life amazing.

feature_entries.title: Smart Switch into the Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Diving right into your new Galaxy Galaxy S23 is easy. Simply transfer your favorite content —photos, calendar dates, alarms and even call history —from your previous phone with Smart Switch.¹⁰

feature_entries.description: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.¹ With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data.
TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL—Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.

GET FURTHER AND CLOSER—The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you takes incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES—The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles anytime you want.

SUPERSMART A18 CHIP—A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

LONGER BATTERY LIFE—iPhone 16 works together with the A18 chip to deliver a big boost in battery life with up to 22 hours video playback.² Charge via USB-C or snap on a MagSafe charger for faster wireless charging.³

DESIGNED TO LAST—iPhone 16 has a sturdy, aerospace-grade aluminum design with a 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display.⁴ It’s remarkably durable with the latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s 2x tougher than any smartphone glass.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR IPHONE—With iOS 18 you can tint your Home Screen icons with any color. Find your favorite shots faster in the redesigned Photos app. And add playful, animated effects to any word, phrase, or emoji in iMessage.ⁱ

SATELLITE CONNECTIVITY—If you don't have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁶ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can't.⁷

Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.¹¹

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.¹²
16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro Fold. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

Big and bright. Inside and out: Inside, you get a massive 8-inch Super Actua Flex display, ready to help you dive into immersive entertainment or find your flow with masterful multitasking.⁴ Outside, there’s a 6.4-inch Actua display that looks and feels great in your hand. And both screens are brighter than ever.⁴,⁵

Fast-charging, all-day battery: Pixel 10 Pro Fold has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 72 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

Tricky editing is effortless with the help of AI: It’s easy to work your editing magic with Pixel. Make complex edits, like removing distractions, moving objects, and merging photos into one where everyone looks their best.⁶
So many ways to selfie: With 10 MP selfie cameras on both the inner and outer screens, you’ll make a habit of snapping perfectly framed selfies.⁷ Love that for you.

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁶

Group pics the whole group loves: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.
Up to 20x the video zoom power: Pixel 10 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens for up to 20x zoom with Super Res Zoom Video and advanced processing to give you smooth, high-quality video.

Let them see it before you snap it: Pixel 10 Pro Fold makes it easy for everyone to pose just right for photos, portraits and videos. While you set up the shot, they can see themselves on the outer screen.

A fun way to get their attention: Take great pictures of your kids with Made You Look. While you frame the photo, they see fun animations that react to their expressions and help them look right at the camera and smile.
The perfect setup for hands-free viewing: Set your Pixel 10 Pro Fold on a surface in tabletop mode for a convenient way to watch your favorites.

Divide. And conquer: Use Split Screen to plan your trip, or drag and drop images into a presentation on the move.⁸ You can also adjust the view smoothly and quickly switch focus with a tap. Productivity, here you come.

products.description: Galaxy AI is here. Search like never before,¹ get real-time interpretation on a call,² format your notes into a clear summary,³ and effortlessly edit your photos⁴ - all from your smartphone, all with AI. S Series has a legacy of pushing the boundaries of what a smartphone can do. And with Galaxy S23 Ultra, we’re raising that bar again. Galaxy S23 Ultra is more than the next big step in mobile tech. With the crystal-clear camera resolution on a phone and stunning Night Mode powered by Nightography, you can share those big moments no matter the lighting. Plus, with the fastest Snapdragon processor yet, juggle high-intensity games, multiple apps or video calls with ease. Write, sketch, edit, create and share from anywhere with a built-in S Pen. And do all of the above on an incredibly large display built for gaming, streaming, creating and doing. Enhance your day-to-day with a device that’s anything but ordinary, and share the epic with Galaxy S23 Ultra.

features: Circle it, search it,¹ find it. Just like that.: What’s your favorite influencer wearing? Where’d they go on vacation? What’s that word mean? Don’t try to describe it use Circle to Search with Google¹ and get the answer in a snap. Simply circle it on your screen to learn more.

Break down barriers to language barriers: Speak foreign languages on the spot with AI-powered Live Translate.² Unlock the power of convenient communication with near-real-time voice translations right through your Samsung Phone app.

Take a great photo. Then make it better.: Turn every photo into a post-worthy masterpiece with Galaxy AI. Move or remove objects. Fill in empty space. Simply snap a pic, and then take it from great to jaw-dropping with Generative Edit³

Be lost in conversation, not translation.: Wish you always had an interpreter on hand? Now you do with Galaxy AI. Simply hold up your phone during face-to-face conversations and receive real-time translations.⁴

Capture the night, even in low light: Ready to own the night? Whether you’re headed to a concert or romantic night out, there’s no such thing as bad lighting with Night Mode. Galaxy S23 Ultra lets you capture epic content in any setting with stunning Nightography.
Capture scenes in stunning detail: Create crystal-clear content worth sharing with Galaxy S23 Ultra 200MP camera. Whether you’re posting or printing, Galaxy S23 Ultra always does the moment justice.

Steady video. Incredibly easy.: Capture incredibly smooth video during life’s most exciting moments. With Video Stabilization, you can easily record daytime outdoor adventures or those spur-of-the-moment dance parties at night.
Upgrade your Note pad: Capture scribbles, strokes of genius and everything in between with the built-in S Pen. Writing your next short story or sketching on the go has never felt this easy.

Take out the S Pen. Take a pic.: Capture epic selfies and beautiful photos with the click of your S Pen. Simply open up the camera app and click the button on the S Pen instead of the screen. Getting that great shot just got easier.
Our fastest mobile processor available: Whether you’re working hard, playing hard or doing both at the same time, smoothly switch between apps with our fastest processor ever.

The power to stay on top of your game: Power through a packed day or a long night of gaming without worrying about your phone dying. The robust 5,000mAh battery has been fine-tuned with a smarter processor that helps manage energy usage without slowing you down.⁵

More storage. More memories.: You’re good on storage space. With an impressive amount of storage, starting at 256GB, you can enjoy being behind the camera without the stress that comes with getting close to filling up your phone.

Watch anything in any light: Watch your content comfortably as Adaptive Vision Booster helps your screen adapt to your environment. Whether out in direct sunlight or in bed with the lights off, the contrast on Galaxy S23 Ultra expansive screen still looks amazing.
Convenient collaboration: Easily answer video calls and collaborate with the team while remote with Galaxy S23 Ultra and Google Meet.⁶

Love it? Share it.: Send even your large files —whether it’s cute puppy videos or work documents —between your Galaxy S23 Ultra and any iOS or Android device. Quick Share helps minimize frustration when sharing the epic.⁷
Snap once. Capture a ton.: Get the group together for one shot and capture a variety of candid moments. Simply tap, record and choose from multiple stills and videos.⁸

Capture memories in stunning 8K Video: Capture memories in stunning detail with 8K Video recording. No matter the moment, Galaxy S23 Ultra lets you shoot ultra-bright, crystal-clear scenes —day or night.

Get back to on the go: Life’s best moments could happen at any second. With a battery that supports up to 45W Super-Fast Charging, it’s easy to stay ready. Power up your Galaxy S23 Ultra quickly and get back to making more memories.⁹
Tough when it matters most: Take on the day confidently with a tough yet stylish phone —one built to resist spills and scratches.
Your phone. Your look. Your style.: Design your own Galaxy experience with Galaxy S23 Ultra. With our versatile One UI, you can personalize a lock screen that reflects your lifestyle.

Designed with our planet in mind: Feel good knowing your new phone supports what you support. Galaxy S23 Ultra was designed to help you live in a more sustainable world, while enjoying everything that makes that life amazing.

Smart Switch into the Galaxy: Diving right into your new Galaxy S23 Ultra is easy. Simply transfer your favorite content —photos, calendar dates, alarms and even call history —from your previous phone with Smart Switch.¹⁰

products.title: Samsung - Galaxy S26+ 256GB (Unlocked) - Black
products.description: Samsung Galaxy S26+ is designed for the moments when creativity strikes — and the pace of your day doesn’t slow down. Powered by Galaxy AI, it helps you shape ideas, express yourself and keep everything moving naturally from inspiration to execution. With Photo Assist, creativity goes far beyond the original shot. Add or remove elements while restoring details or apply artistic styles like painting, black-and-white or playful illustrations to reimagine your photos in seconds. It’s an easy, intuitive way to give your images a new perspective — no additional apps required. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI takes those ideas even further. Create custom stickers, personalized profile pictures or entirely new images with a simple prompt. Whether you’re refining a memory or starting from scratch, Galaxy S26+ makes it effortless to turn imagination into something tangible and ready to share. As ideas turn into action, Galaxy S26+ keeps everything in sync. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI supports your conversations by surfacing helpful actions like adding events, viewing your calendar, sharing photos, browsing locations or sending contact details — right when they make sense. And with ProScaler enhancing sharpness and color automatically, everything you create, read and type looks clearer and more vibrant throughout the day. Samsung Galaxy S26+ brings creativity and momentum together — helping you express more, organize faster and move through your day with ease.

features: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.
Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26+ and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

products.full_description: Pricing: One-time price: $999.99 (regular $1099.99); Monthly payment: $41.67 for 24 months via Best Buy financing Samsung Galaxy S26+ is designed for the moments when creativity strikes — and the pace of your day doesn’t slow down. Powered by Galaxy AI, it helps you shape ideas, express yourself and keep everything moving naturally from inspiration to execution. With Photo Assist, creativity goes far beyond the original shot. Add or remove elements while restoring details or apply artistic styles like painting, black-and-white or playful illustrations to reimagine your photos in seconds. It’s an easy, intuitive way to give your images a new perspective — no additional apps required. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI takes those ideas even further. Create custom stickers, personalized profile pictures or entirely new images with a simple prompt. Whether you’re refining a memory or starting from scratch, Galaxy S26+ makes it effortless to turn imagination into something tangible and ready to share. As ideas turn into action, Galaxy S26+ keeps everything in sync. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI supports your conversations by surfacing helpful actions like adding events, viewing your calendar, sharing photos, browsing locations or sending contact details — right when they make sense. And with ProScaler enhancing sharpness and color automatically, everything you create, read and type looks clearer and more vibrant throughout the day. Samsung Galaxy S26+ brings creativity and momentum together — helping you express more, organize faster and move through your day with ease. Features: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.; Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.; Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.; Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.; Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³; Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.; Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.; Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.; Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26+ and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.; A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today. products.description: Staying in the moment is easier than ever with the all-new Galaxy S25 Ultra. Its intelligent AI transforms into your own virtual assistant that evolves with you to work better for you. Let’s say you want to enjoy a night out with friends but don’t have time to plan. Just ask Galaxy S25 Ultra to invite your friends to the nearest bowling lounge tonight. Your phone will find the info and text it to them. You don’t need to slow down your speech or speak like a robot —just talk to your phone naturally, and it will understand. While you’re out rolling spares, Night Video brings out the details in every moment —even in low light —while Audio Eraser makes it easy to reduce distracting noises, like those pins crashing one lane over. Galaxy S25 Ultra also keeps up with your schedule and provides the weather forecast for your night, allowing you to stay a step ahead and adjust plans on the fly. With a phone as evolved as Galaxy S25 Ultra, you don’t have to sweat the small stuff —it’s handled intelligently.

products.page_description: Staying in the moment is easier than ever with the all-new Galaxy S25 Ultra. Its intelligent AI transforms into your own virtual assistant that evolves with you to work better for you. Let’s say you want to enjoy a night out with friends but don’t have time to plan. Just ask Galaxy S25 Ultra to invite your friends to the nearest bowling lounge tonight. Your phone will find the info and text it to them. You don’t need to slow down your speech or speak like a robot —just talk to your phone naturally, and it will understand. While you’re out rolling spares, Night Video brings out the details in every moment —even in low light —while Audio Eraser makes it easy to reduce distracting noises, like those pins crashing one lane over. Galaxy S25 Ultra also keeps up with your schedule and provides the weather forecast for your night, allowing you to stay a step ahead and adjust plans on the fly. With a phone as evolved as Galaxy S25 Ultra, you don’t have to sweat the small stuff —it’s handled intelligently.
features: Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever before. Have it Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend. Ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Free up more time to do the things you love with a phone that handles multiple tasks with one simple command.¹

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it. Galaxy S25 Ultra gives you personalized insights based on your schedule. For example, if it’s going to rain, your phone will remind you to grab an umbrella before heading out.²

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic: With Galaxy S25 Ultra, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³

Bring out the best in every face: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on Galaxy S25 Ultra. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.
More power to you: The upgraded processor on Galaxy S25 Ultra handles complex AI features effortlessly.

Your images, clearer than ever: Your images feel life like on Galaxy S25 Ultra thanks to a brilliant display with ProScaler. Enjoy sharper visuals and brighter colors on a screen that makes details pop.⁴

One simple number. A world of insights.: Start your day in the know using Energy Score with Galaxy AI. It’s a daily score based off yesterday’s sleep, activity and heart rate, all collected by your Galaxy Ring or Watch. Then go deeper and discover insights for how to improve it on your Galaxy S25 Ultra device.⁵

Track your sleep from your wrist to your phone: Get an edge on your competition when you learn better sleep habits with the help of Galaxy AI. Track your sleep with your Galaxy Watch Ultra, and then get in-depth personalized tips on your Galaxy S25 Ultra device to put you on a path to feeling well rested.⁵

Stay up to date while your screen stays locked: Stay in the know on the go with Now Bar. It provides really quick updates, right on the lock screen of your Galaxy S25 Ultra device. Customize what you want to see —from your team’s latest score on Google Sports to your Energy Score on Samsung Health —then see it at a glance on your Now Bar. It even seamlessly connects with the all-new Now Brief so you can conveniently get helpful tips throughout your day.⁶

Stay charged. And in charge.: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25 Ultra. Built with long-lasting batteries, these phones optimize energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging.⁷ Also, charge your phone from 0% to 65% in just 30 minutes.⁹

Boost your gameplay with a boss-level battery: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy S25 Ultra is the ultimate boost for on-the-go gaming. It’s engineered to use energy efficiently so you can complete entire quests, compete in rounds of online tournaments and run circles around your rivals without worrying about your phone running on empty.
Clearly capture the complete picture: No need to step back. Stay where you are and snap the entire scene in full detail with the 50MP Ultra Wide lens on Galaxy S25 Ultra.

A shortcut to your favorite AI tools: With AI Select on Galaxy S25 Ultra, you’ve got easy access to powerful tools that help you do more with just about anything you see on your screen. Say you’ve found a piece of text or an image you like, take a screenshot and then access AI Select. Your phone uses AI to analyze your selection and then offers you a variety of tools you can use to take that piece of content even further.

Redesigned from the inside out: Galaxy S25 Ultra redefines the way you interact with your phone. Its ergonomic design features smoother edges and a comfortable grip for effortless handling, while the redesigned One UI 7 streamlines every task. Whether you’re enjoying long gaming sessions or navigating Galaxy AI tools, Galaxy S25 Ultra feels as good as it performs.
Switching is quick and easy: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S25 Ultra. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of tap to pay with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung’s Knox technology.⁸

A great phone for the whole family: Google Pixel 10a is tough enough for everyday drops, and its family settings make it easy for you and your kids to stay on the same page.

products.title: Apple - Pre-Owned Excellent iPhone 12 5G 64GB (Unlocked) - Black
products.description: iPhone 12 has it all. 5G on iPhone is super fast, so you can download movies on the fly and stream high-quality video. You can do it in more places, because iPhone 12 has 5G coverage worldwide. OLED delivers brighter brights, darker blacks, and higher resolution for everything you look at. Both the Wide and Ultra Wide cameras now have Night mode to capture incredible low-light shots. Night mode senses when light is low and kicks in automatically, maintaining clarity while capturing beautiful vibrant color. All you have to do is start snapping. Deep Fusion, in mid to low light, analyzes multiple exposures to maximize detail. Check out the texture in the wood, fabric, and crystal. And the Ultra Wide gets you a heroic perspective. Smart HDR 3 balances the elements in a shot, bringing out detail in the subject and trees while retaining the rich color of the sky — even at high noon. Beyond faces, Smart HDR 3 uses machine learning to recognize scenes, then adjusts sharpness, color, and white balance where needed. Even in bright light, Smart HDR 3 is amazing at capturing texture, skin tone, color saturation, and individual details that make photos feel TRUE to life. Portrait mode artfully blurs the background to put all the focus on your subject. Then there’s Night mode Time-lapse. Just prop up your iPhone and let the light trails begin. Now you can record 4K HDR video with Dolby Vision; edit in Photos or iMovie. Then zap it to your TV using AirPlay to see all that color and detail. It’s a start-to-finish cinematic experience. iOS 14 is packed with shortcuts that get you just what you want, right when you want it. iPhone is designed to protect your information. Face ID data doesn’t leave your iPhone and is never backed up to iCloud or anywhere else. iOS shows you an app’s privacy practices before you download it. When you use Apple Pay, your card number isn’t shared with merchants. And the list goes on. To charge your new iPhone, you can continue to use your USB‑A to Lightning cable. Or you can take advantage of fast charging with the USB‑C to Lightning cable now included in the box, which works with existing USB‑C power adapters and computer ports.

products.description: Your life is dynamic, so your phone should be too. Galaxy Z Flip7 moves with you, flexing to whatever your day throws your way. It opens to an expanded 6.9" screen that delivers a more comfortable user experience, then folds down small enough to fit in your palm, pocket or purse. And all that flexibility comes without compromise. The 50MP high res camera captures crisp shots day or night, while FlexCam lets you shoot hands free from almost any angle. On the cover, the larger FlexWindow lets you quickly access smart tools like Now Brief, while the new MultiStar integration makes it easier than ever to add your favorite widgets to your front screen. Plus, FlexWindow is fully customizable, allowing you to create your own screen or select from a variety of fun designs that help you make your phone feel more you. You can even switch playlists or talk to Google Gemini to get assistance on the fly all without opening your Flip. With its convenient and pocketable design, this phone transforms in to what you need when you need it. Galaxy Z Flip7- the phone that flexes with you.

features: Flip into full-day battery power: The battery life you need, packed into the foldable you want. Galaxy Z Flip7 features the biggest battery on a Z Flip that lasts through busy schedules, long shoots and late-night scrolls.¹ The battery on Galaxy Z Flip7 was made for those unpredictable days so you can do more, charge less and still finish the day with power to spare.

Flex it and free your hands: Go hands-free when you stream, video call or take pics on Galaxy Z Flip7. With FlexMode, Galaxy Z Flip7 stays open at just the right angle, giving you the perfect view of recipes, timers, content or anything else on your screen.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy Z Flip7. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of Tap to Pay² with the peace of mind knowing your purchase is secured by Samsung Knox technology.

Tap phones, pay friends: The new feature of Samsung Wallet, Tap to Transfer, enables you to send³ money to your friend’s or family member’s bank account associated with their debit card —even if they use Apple Walletor Google Wallet. Just tap phones and they’ll be sent the funds within minutes.⁴

Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever. Ask Google Gemini, “Search for the top three sushi spots in uptown and text it to Angela and Garrett.” Or ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Galaxy Z Flip7 helps you free up more time to do the things you love by handling multiple tasks with one simple command.⁵

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it.⁶ Now Brief on Galaxy Z Flip7 provides you with personalized insights to help you prepare for your day, including information about your daily appointments, the weather and more.

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic.: With Galaxy Z Flip7, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.⁷

Capture everyone’s good side every time: In every group photo, there’s almost always someone who blinked or didn’t smile. With Galaxy Z Flip7, you can ensure the group looks their best.⁹ Use Best Face with Galaxy AI⁸ to find everyone’s most flattering face, and then combine them into one stunning photo worth sharing.

Selfies that stun: Effortlessly elevate your selfie game on Galaxy Z Flip7. Galaxy AI⁸ recognizes your environment’s lighting and captures accurate skin tones and textures so each portrait brings out everyone’s best side —without the extra editing.¹⁰

A shortcut to your best shots: Looking for that picture of your dog wearing a leprechaun costume from St. Patrick’s Day? Simply describe the pic to your Galaxy Z Flip7 device and it finds it for you in seconds. Gone are the days of endlessly scrolling through your Gallery,¹¹ giving you more time to compose the perfect throwback post.

products.title: Apple - iPhone 17 Pro 512GB - Silver (Verizon)
products.description: iPhone 17 Pro. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.3-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and breakthrough battery life.
products.page_description: iPhone 17 Pro. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.3-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and breakthrough battery life.
features: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks². And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BREAKTHROUGH BATTERY LIFE—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 33 hours of video playback.⁴ Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.⁵

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7¹⁰, 5G networks¹¹, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹²

products.page_description: Escape the ordinary with Google Pixel 10. It has Pixel’s most powerful chip, an incredible camera, and Gemini built in to supercharge your productivity and creativity.¹
features: Universal Unlocked: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

You show, Gemini tells: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.¹⁰

Get 6 months of the Google One Premium 2 TB plan: Get access to 2 TB of cloud storage from Google One and automatic phone backup for your photos, videos, contacts, and more. Plus, you can share your plan with up to 5 others.

Powerhouse performance: Pixel 10 runs fast and smooth with 12 GB of RAM. And it’s designed to handle Google’s advanced AI, giving you innovative photo and video editing, and powerful Gemini features.¹

Easy on the eyes, even in direct sunlight: Pixel 10’s 6.3-inch Actua display with 3,000-nit peak brightness is sharp and vibrant, with better readability outdoors.⁴ And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

A battery that lasts. And charges fast: Pixel 10 has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

True-to-life images. Out-of-this-world editing: Pixel 10 has an upgraded advanced triple camera system, with a new 5x telephoto lens and Super Res Zoom up to 20x. So it’s easy to capture stunning photos and videos in almost any light, and make complex edits with a few taps.
Step up your selfies: Take sharp, clear, share-worthy selfies with the 10.5 MP camera and autofocus.⁵ And when you want to fit more in, the 95° field of view makes it a snap.⁶

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

Group pics the whole group loves: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.

Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

products.page_description: Meet Pixel 10 Pro, the new standard for pro phones. Advanced AI with Gemini, unbelievable camera quality, impeccable design, and the next-gen Google Tensor G5 chip.¹
features: Universal Unlocked: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

You show, Gemini tells: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.⁶
16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

The brightest display ever on a Pixel: See your phone in a whole new light with 3,300-nit peak brightness.⁴ The new Super Actua display makes your screen look immersive and vibrant, even in direct sunlight. And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

Fast-charging, all-day battery: Pixel 10 Pro XL has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

Studio-quality photos. Pro-level videos: Pixel’s pro camera system makes everything look amazing by default, even in low light. Capture more of the scene with advanced AI models, and bring out incredible details with up to 100x zoom, stunning 50 MP images, and super steady videos in 8K with Video Boost.⁵

Amazing selfies of you, and everyone else: The 42 MP front camera with autofocus features a 103° field of view – Pixel’s widest, most selfie-ready yet.⁵ You and the whole group come out remarkably sharp in photos or videos, even in dimly lit situations like restaurants and concerts.

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

Group pics the whole group loves: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.
Up to 20x the video zoom power: Pixel 10 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens for up to 20x zoom with Super Res Zoom Video and advanced processing to give you smooth, high-quality video.
Low-light videos get a glow-up: Night Sight Video with Video Boost brings out the highest-quality 8K recordings on a Pixel for even richer scenes of sunset skylines and candlelit dinners.

Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

products.page_description: Make life easier with an epic phone that really gets you. The intuitive Galaxy S25+ features the latest in AI to help make every day more effortless. Save time with a phone that feels almost like a real live personal assistant. Meeting friends for a night out? Ask your phone to search for the closest vegan restaurant and then text it to them. Galaxy S25+ handles multiple tasks with a single ask, freeing up time so you can focus on your look. Did you get to the restaurant early? Scroll through your feed on a display that enhances images on your screen, making all your favorite photos pop, with ProScaler. Better yet, rack up a few likes of your own with a stunning selfie captured with an improved camera that brings out the best in every face so your true self shines through. Rain expected on your way home? Luckily, your phone let you know before you headed out, keeping you a step ahead. Galaxy S25+ isn’t just an AI-enhanced phone —it’s a way to take some of the hassle out of your everyday.
features: Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever before. Have it Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend.
Ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Free up more time to do the things you love with a phone that handles multiple tasks with one simple command.¹

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it. Galaxy S25+ gives you personalized insights based on your schedule. For example, if it’s going to rain, your phone will remind you to grab an umbrella before heading out.²

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic: With Galaxy S25+, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³

Bring out the best in every face: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on Galaxy S25+. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.
More power to you: The upgraded processor on Galaxy S25+ handles complex AI features effortlessly.

The display your content deserves: Galaxy S25+ helps you get your head in the game with lifelike details on an incredible display. Watch the worlds of your favorite games come to life with intricate reflections, realistic shadows and vivid lighting effects.⁴
Your images, clearer than ever: Your images feel life like on Galaxy S25+ thanks to a brilliant display with ProScaler. Enjoy sharper visuals and brighter colors on a screen that makes details pop.⁵

One simple number. A world of insights.: Start your day in the know using Energy Score with Galaxy AI. It’s a daily score based off yesterday’s sleep, activity and heart rate, all collected by your Galaxy Ring or Watch. Then go deeper and discover insights for how to improve it on your Galaxy S25+ device.⁶

Track your sleep from your wrist to your phone: Get an edge on your competition when you learn better sleep habits with the help of Galaxy AI. Track your sleep with your Galaxy Watch Ultra, and then get in-depth personalized tips on your Galaxy S25+ device to put you on a path to feeling well rested.⁶
Stay up to date while your screen stays locked: Stay in the know on the go with Now Bar. It provides really quick updates, right on the lock screen of your Galaxy S25+ device.

Customize what you want to see —from your team’s latest score on Google Sports to your Energy Score on Samsung Health —then see it at a glance on your Now Bar. It even seamlessly connects with the all-new Now Brief so you can conveniently get helpful tips throughout your day.⁷

Stay charged. And in charge.: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25+. Built with long-lasting batteries, these phones optimize energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging.⁸ Also, charge your phone from 0% to 65% in 30 minutes.¹⁰

Boost your gameplay with a boss-level battery: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy S25+ is the ultimate boost for on-the-go gaming. It’s engineered to use energy efficiently so you can complete entire quests, compete in rounds of online tournaments and run circles around your rivals without worrying about your phone running on empty.
A shortcut to your favorite AI tools: With AI Select on Galaxy S25+, you’ve got easy access to powerful tools that help you do more with just about anything you see on your screen.

Say you’ve found a piece of text or an image you like, take a screenshot and then access AI Select. Your phone uses AI to analyze your selection and then offers you a variety of tools you can use to take that piece of content even further.
Switching is quick and easy: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S25+. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of tap to pay with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung’s Knox technology.⁹

products.page_description: Galaxy S25 FE brings upgraded essentials to level up your everyday. Its lightweight and sleek design makes it easy to carry; and wrapped in durable Gorilla Glass Victus+ and a sturdy Armor Aluminum frame, it’s built to go wherever life takes you. The 6.7" full HD display with barely there bezels gives you more room to see and do and ensures smooth scrolling with a refresh rate up to120Hz. Plus, S25 FE brings smart assistance to your everyday with Gemini Live. Show Gemini what you see with camera sharing, and ask questions in real time. Add to that an advanced camera. Whether you're snapping a quick selfie or editing vacation footage, S25 FE helps you get the shot and polish it too. The triple lens rear camera system captures every angle with clarity, and the 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine makes every shot count from bright daytime photos to clear low light moments. Plus, now you can erase audio, adjust skin tone, resize objects and more with AI powered Generative Edit. With a faster CPU, GPU and NPU, a larger vapor chamber for better cooling and a 4,900mAh battery with Super Fast Charging 2.0, Galaxy S25 FE delivers steady performance that carries you through your day. It’s the everyday ready device with smart, powerful, premium features that actually make a difference.
features: Big. Bright. Smooth.: Galaxy S25 FE makes room for more¹ of what you love with a 6.7” FHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display² and slimmer bezels that expand your view. Whether you’re scrolling or streaming, a refresh rate of up to 120Hz keeps every movement smooth and seamless, while rich colors and crisp clarity pull you deeper into every scene.

Packed with strength, for your everyday: You shouldn’t have to treat your phone like it’s fragile. And with Galaxy S25 FE, you don’t have to. Its upgraded¹ Armor Aluminum frame and Gorilla Glass Victus+ offer lasting durability, helping protect your device from the daily bumps and mishaps³ that come with life on the go.

Selfies that stun: Whether the sun’s shining or the stars are out, Galaxy S25 FE makes every moment share worthy. The 12MP front camera with ProVisual Engine uses Super HDR and low noise modes⁴ to capture amazing portraits and next level selfies, day or night. Plus, you can now easily edit your videos with Audio Eraser⁵ to make sure your videos sound as good as they look.

Move it. Remove it. Improve it.: Take control of your photos like never before. With Generative Edit⁶ on Galaxy S25 FE, you can move, resize or erase anything in the frame no do over required. Want to remove a stranger in the background or reposition an object? With Galaxy AI it's easy to make your images look exactly as you imagined.

More power. Less plugging in: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25 FE. Built with a more powerful 4,900mAh battery,¹ it optimizes energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging. And when you do need to top it off, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁸ gets you back in action in no time.⁷

Show Gemini, get instant help: Sometimes it’s easier to show than explain.⁹ With your Galaxy S25 FE, share your camera while using Gemini Live, and your AI assistant can see what you see and respond in real time. Just point your camera and let Gemini Live offer up ideas, answers or suggestions based on what’s in the frame. From menu suggestions, to interpreting symbols on garments for special washing, it’s a smarter way to search that uses what you see.

Lightweight design, everyday ease: Galaxy S25 FE is lightweight and designed to keep up without weighing you down. Whether you’re tossing it in a bag, slipping it into your pocket or holding it in your palm, it’s easy to carry and hard to put down.

Powerful performance, now accessible: When your phone can think faster, everything else follows. Galaxy S25 FE is equipped with a premium processor that delivers faster CPU, GPU and NPU speeds. That means smoother multitasking, quicker reactions and a sustained performance through your day with its improved cooling system. It’s a serious upgrade that makes everyday feel effortless.¹

See it big. Hear it better.: Galaxy S25 FE and Buds3 FE¹⁰ are a match made in content heaven. With a wider display¹ and bold, balanced audio, your favorite shows, games and videos feel immersive from the first second. The expansive screen and powerful sound work together to turn screen time into an experience.

Talk to Gemini, hands free: Have your hands full? No problem. Access Gemini on your Galaxy phone hands free with Galaxy Buds3 FE,¹⁰ using your voice.¹¹ Whether you're mid commute or mid workout, get help with texts, reminders, directions and more, all without reaching for your phone.

Move between your Galaxy devices. Your Buds follow.: No need to dig through menus or re pair every time you change devices. Galaxy Buds3 FE pair by opening the cradle¹² and know exactly when to follow you from phone to Tab to PC.¹³ So whatever you're listening to, the switch is smooth and the connection is constant.

It’s a serious upgrade that makes everyday feel effortless.¹; See it big. Hear it better.: Galaxy S25 FE and Buds3 FE¹⁰ are a match made in content heaven. Your Buds follow.: No need to dig through menus or re pair every time you change devices. Galaxy Buds3 FE pair by opening the cradle¹² and know exactly when to follow you from phone to Tab to PC.¹³ So whatever you're listening to, the switch is smooth and the connection is constant. products.page_description: Expand what’s possible with Galaxy Z Fold7, the foldable that’s designed to do so much more than before. The expanded 6.5" cover display is made to feel like a traditional smartphone, making it more convenient to handle daily tasks from text replies to checking the weather without needing to unfold. For even more possibilities, open up the impressive 8" screen to create, unwind, multitask and more. For the first time ever for a foldable, Galaxy Z Fold7 boasts a 200MP camera with ProVisual Engine so you can take stunning photos with ease. Perfecting your pics feels just as effortless. Enjoy plenty of room on the expansive inner screen to make tiny adjustments, like zooming in to delete that stranger in the background with Photo Assist or ensuring everyone’s eyes are open in the group selfie with Best Face. Whether you’re at home or on the go, creating on the large screen of Galaxy Z Fold7 is as comfortable as it gets. View up to three windows at once and edit your content on one side while streaming videos and scrolling social feeds on the other. While you multitask, the customized Snapdragon 8 Elite processor for Galaxy keeps your experiences smooth from start to finish. Plus, you can do it all without fear. Galaxy Z Fold7 is crafted with time tested durability that stands up to everyday wear and tear. Now that Gemini Live can analyze what you see, Galaxy Z Fold7 also expands the ways AI can assist you. Simply open up Gemini Live, and then screenshare or point your camera at whatever interests you for additional info or answers on the fly. Live life to the fullest see more, do more and expand what’s possible with Galaxy Z Fold7.
features: Stay locked in without being plugged in: Galaxy Z Fold7 gives you the green light to stay productive with a battery that stays out of the red zone. Use the expansive screen of Galaxy Z Fold7 to video call a friend and catch up for hours or binge the latest season of your favorite TV show while you shop online. Whatever’s on your agenda, Galaxy Z Fold7 is packed with plenty of battery power to fuel your most packed days.¹

Phone stays cool. Games stay fired up.: Let your gaming sessions go for as long as you want on the big screen of Galaxy Z Fold7. Its advanced cooling system prevents overheating so your phone stays cool to the touch while you play for hours on end.

A standout phone that stands up: A phone that props itself up? What a flex. Simply put Galaxy Z Fold7 in FlexMode, set it down and then comfortably watch all your favorite content. Want to skip ahead? Use the bottom half as a touchpad to fast forward. In the mood to create your own content? Just place Galaxy Z Fold7 down and hit record. No need to prop it up or use a tripod.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy Z Fold7. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of Tap to Pay² with the peace of mind knowing your purchase is secured by Samsung Knox technology.

Tap phones, pay friends: The new feature of Samsung Wallet, Tap to Transfer, enables you to send³ money to your friend’s or family member’s bank account associated with their debit card —even if they use Apple Walletor Google Wallet. Just tap phones and they’ll be sent the funds within minutes.⁴

Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever. Ask Google Gemini, “Search for the top three sushi spots in uptown and text it to Angela and Garrett.” Or ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Galaxy Z Fold7 helps you free up more time to do the things you love by handling multiple tasks with one simple command.⁵

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it.⁶ Now Brief on Galaxy Z Fold7 provides you with personalized insights to help you prepare for your day, including information about your daily appointments, the weather and more.

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic.: With Galaxy Z Fold7, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.⁷

Capture everyone’s good side every time: In every group photo, there’s almost always someone who blinked or didn’t smile. With Galaxy Z Fold7, you can ensure the group looks their best.⁹ Use Best Face with Galaxy AI⁸ to find everyone’s most flattering face, and then combine them into one stunning photo worth sharing.

Selfies that stun: Effortlessly elevate your selfie game on Galaxy Z Fold7. Galaxy AI⁸ recognizes your environment’s lighting and captures accurate skin tones and textures so each portrait brings out everyone’s best side —without the extra editing.¹⁰

A shortcut to your best shots: Looking for that picture of your dog wearing a leprechaun costume from St. Patrick’s Day? Simply describe the pic to your Galaxy Z Fold7 device and it finds it for you in seconds. Gone are the days of endlessly scrolling through your Gallery,¹¹ giving you more time to compose the perfect throwback post.

products.page_description: With a lighter, sleeker and more stylish design, Galaxy A56 5G comes loaded with features that make doing awesome things easy. The triple-lens camera lets you capture amazing photos and videos, whether you are shooting lush landscapes or adorable selfies. With Awesome Intelligence, you can easily edit out unwanted objects or make sure everyone looks their best in a group photo. And with tons of internal storge, you can keep more of your favorite memories. 5G connectivity makes browsing, sharing and streaming a breeze. Plus, the Super AMOLED display brings all your favorite content to life in bright, vivid detail. And while you’re doing it all, Knox Security keeps your personal info private and safe. Stylish, smart, durable. Galaxy A56 5G takes awesome to a whole new level.
features: Awesomely light: The sleek, light design of Galaxy A56 5G makes it easier and more comfortable to hold as you browse, snap and share.
Awesomely vivid detail: The ultra-clear 6.7" display¹ of Galaxy A56 5G helps you enjoy the latest shows, your favorite pics or fun social videos in awesome detail.

Delight in the details: Galaxy A56 5G comes equipped with a triple-lens camera. A 50MP main camera gets great details, even at a distance. The 12MP wide camera allows you to get stunning clarity in your broader shots. And your 12MP front-facing camera gives you amazing selfies with a simple click.

Lasts long. Charges fast.: The 5,000mAh battery in Galaxy A56 5G lets you do what you want without worrying about running out of power. And the 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0² recharges your phone faster so you can get back to doing awesome things faster.

The speed you need: Galaxy A56 5G³ keeps you connected with faster speeds so you can enjoy every online experience with ease. Stream videos, share photos, video call or simply surf your favorite sites without interruption.

Keep your data safe: Never worry about a security breach with Samsung Knox, especially with the included six years of OS / security updates.⁴ This multilayered security platform keeps all your private files and data safeguarded.

The Privacy Dashboard lets you manage permissions, monitor history and keep track of sensitive materials. You can also securely share photos and videos safely with the blockchain technology of Private Share.

Designed tough: Galaxy A56 5G looks great, but it’s also built tough. With a metal frame and a Gorilla Glass Victus+ screen, this phone is designed to stand up to everyday use. Plus, the improved IP67 rating⁵ means A56 5G can stand up to dust and water without breaking a sweat.
Keep every memory: With improved internal storage options of either 128GB or 256GB, Galaxy A56 5G lets you keep your favorite pics, videos and memories.⁶

Awesome Intelligence at your fingertips: The Awesome Intelligence of Galaxy A56 5G is like having a suite of superpowers. You can find answers quicker using Circle to Search with Google.⁷ Plus, get the photos and videos you want with tools like Best Face, Object Eraser and Auto Trim. A56 5G makes it easy.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Paying for things has never been easier, thanks to Samsung Wallet. Pay your friends with a tap, even if they have a different device. Keep IDs and your payment and membership cards securely in one digital space that you can use just about anywhere. You can even have your phone act as your car keys. Do it all in one simple-to-use app⁸.

Enjoy all things awesome: Just when you think your phone can’t get any more awesome, we throw in a few extras. Your Galaxy A56 5G comes with amazing packages, like three months of free Peacock Premium⁹.

products.page_description: iPhone 17 Pro Max. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.9-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and best-ever battery life.
features: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks.² And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BEST BATTERY LIFE IN AN IPHONE EVER—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 39 hours of video playback.#&8308; Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.#&8309;

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7¹⁰, 5G networks¹¹, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹²

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 Pro Max activates with an eSIM¹². With eSIM, you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY— A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

products.page_description: Refurbished Excellent
features: Perfectly framed pics, powered by Galaxy AI: Capture stunning hands-free photos from any angle using FlexCam with Galaxy AI¹ as it frames your shot automatically. Whether you’re posing in front of a famous landmark or want to get the whole group in, FlexCam² will keep everything you want in frame and zoom in for a gorgeously clear photo.

You take the pic. Galaxy AI does the rest.: Unleash your creativity without the baggage. Galaxy Z Flip6 takes great photos and easily fixes imperfections, moves objects and enhances colors using Photo Assist with Galaxy AI.¹ ³

Flex a new way to capture video: Capture social content in a fun new way with Camcorder Mode. When held in FlexMode, Galaxy Z Flip6 lets you easily control the cam with one hand and use Smooth Zoom control to record moments as they happen.

Your tiny, mighty translator: Say bye to being lost in translation and hi to fluency in up to 16 languages using Interpreter with Galaxy AI. While in FlexMode, your phone displays translations on both sides of the screen for easy in-person conversation.¹ ⁴

AI-powered assistance, open or closed: Complete simple tasks and send texts without opening your phone on FlexWindow with Galaxy AI. Get quick reply text suggestions based on the context of your conversation, use Bixby to change songs hands-free and more.¹

Personalized from the outside in: Personalize your cover screen to fit your evolving style with wallpapers that change based on time and weather. No matter the moment, there’s always something new to see on your Galaxy Z Flip6.¹

Galaxy AI power, perfect for pockets: Big innovation now fits in your pocket or purse with Galaxy Z Flip6. All you need to stay connected and capture gorgeous shots can easily fold to fit into whatever you wear or carry.

Strikingly slim. Refreshingly light.: Enjoy on-the-go convenience with Galaxy Z Flip6 —the small phone that makes a big statement. No matter the pocket, purse or bag, its light and slim design fits perfectly into your adventurous lifestyle.
Tiny, but tough: It’s tiny, but tough. Galaxy Z Flip6 is built to last with Gorilla Glass Victus 2, IP48 water resistance⁹ and a pre-installed screen protector so you can flip worry-free.

A cover screen that has you covered: Get more done with your phone closed. Galaxy Z Flip6 lets you quickly reply to messages, get directions and easily check your favorite apps, all from the convenience of your cover screen.

Love your health? Put a ring on it.: Take control of your health by marrying Galaxy Z Flip6 with Galaxy Ring. Designed for those on the go, Galaxy Ring lets you comfortably keep tabs on your health with sleep tracking, Energy Score and Wellness Tips —all easily viewable on the FlexWindow of your Galaxy Z Flip6.⁶

Phone to ear —translations you can hear: Get lost in conversation, not translation, when you pair Galaxy Z Flip6 with Buds3 Pro to hear live translations in your ear. Using Interpreter with Galaxy AI, you can hear what the person in front of you is saying in your language, even while they speak another.
