products.page_description: Imagine a new phone that truly simplifies your day. Galaxy S25 does more than keep your world all in one place —it uses AI to intuitively streamline your life. What if you could plan a night out with your friends with one simple ask? Your personal assistant will find the perfect spot and text it to them. Want to keep tabs on your busy day ahead? Galaxy S25 gives you the insights you need before you know you need them with Now Brief. Want to wow with your content? Capture and curate post-worthy shots every time with an incredible high-res camera. Looking for a phone that can truly keep up with you? Galaxy S25 is built with a long-lasting battery. What if you could experience epic tech that brings ease to your everyday? Galaxy S25 does just that.
features: Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever before. Have it Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend.
Ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Free up more time to do the things you love with a phone that handles multiple tasks with one simple command.¹

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it. Galaxy S25 gives you personalized insights based on your schedule. For example, if it’s going to rain, your phone will remind you to grab an umbrella before heading out.²

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic: With Galaxy S25, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³

Bring out the best in every face: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on Galaxy S25. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.
More power to you: The upgraded processor on Galaxy S25 handles complex AI features effortlessly.

The display your content deserves: Galaxy S25 helps you get your head in the game with lifelike details on an incredible display. Watch the worlds of your favorite games come to life with intricate reflections, realistic shadows and vivid lighting effects.⁴

One simple number. A world of insights.: Start your day in the know using Energy Score with Galaxy AI. It’s a daily score based off yesterday’s sleep, activity and heart rate, all collected by your Galaxy Ring or Watch. Then go deeper and discover insights for how to improve it on your Galaxy S25 device.⁵

Track your sleep from your wrist to your phone: Get an edge on your competition when you learn better sleep habits with the help of Galaxy AI. Track your sleep with your Galaxy Watch Ultra, and then get in-depth personalized tips on your Galaxy S25 device to put you on a path to feeling well rested.⁵
Stay up to date while your screen stays locked: Stay in the know on the go with Now Bar. It provides really quick updates, right on the lock screen of your Galaxy S25 device.

Customize what you want to see —from your team’s latest score on Google Sports to your Energy Score on Samsung Health —then see it at a glance on your Now Bar. It even seamlessly connects with the all-new Now Brief so you can conveniently get helpful tips throughout your day.⁶

Stay charged. And in charge.: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25. Built with long-lasting batteries, these phones optimize energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging.⁷ Also, charge your phone from 0% to 50% in just 30 minutes.⁹

Boost your gameplay with a boss-level battery: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy S25 is the ultimate boost for on-the-go gaming. It’s engineered to use energy efficiently so you can complete entire quests, compete in rounds of online tournaments and run circles around your rivals without worrying about your phone running on empty.
A shortcut to your favorite AI tools: With AI Select on Galaxy S25, you’ve got easy access to powerful tools that help you do more with just about anything you see on your screen.

Say you’ve found a piece of text or an image you like, take a screenshot and then access AI Select. Your phone uses AI to analyze your selection and then offers you a variety of tools you can use to take that piece of content even further.
Switching is quick and easy: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S25. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of tap to pay with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung’s Knox technology.⁸

products.description: At the heart of iPhone SE you’ll find the same superpowerful A15 Bionic chip that’s in iPhone 13. A highly efficient chip, an enhanced battery, and iOS 15 work together to boost battery life. When you do need to charge, just place iPhone SE on a wireless charger. Or connect a 20W or higher adapter to fast charge from zero to up to 50 percent charge in 30 minutes flat. From livestreaming to multiplayer gaming to video sharing, 5G really speeds things up. It even makes FaceTime in high definition and SharePlay feel smooth and seamless when you’re on the go. When you don’t need all that speed, iPhone SE shifts into Smart Data mode to preserve battery life. iPhone SE shrugs off spills from common liquids such as water, soda, coffee, tea, and juice. And it’s certainly not bothered by a little dust, either. Touch ID is a fast, simple, and secure way to unlock your phone and sign in to apps. You can even use it with Apple Pay to do things like shop online or grab groceries at the store — all without reaching for your card. Give your camera direction with Photographic Styles. Choose a look — such as Warm or Cool — and iPhone SE selectively applies the adjustments, keeping skies and skin tones natural. So your photos will automatically have the look you love. Go ahead, keep the camera rolling. The enhanced video on iPhone SE picks up an incredible amount of detail — including contours, shadows, and highlights — even when the sun goes down.

products.page_description: Escape the ordinary with Google Pixel 10. It has Pixel’s most powerful chip, an incredible camera, and Gemini built in to supercharge your productivity and creativity.¹
features: Universal Unlocked: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

You show, Gemini tells: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.¹⁰

Get 6 months of the Google One Premium 2 TB plan: Get access to 2 TB of cloud storage from Google One and automatic phone backup for your photos, videos, contacts, and more. Plus, you can share your plan with up to 5 others.

Powerhouse performance: Pixel 10 runs fast and smooth with 12 GB of RAM. And it’s designed to handle Google’s advanced AI, giving you innovative photo and video editing, and powerful Gemini features.¹

Easy on the eyes, even in direct sunlight: Pixel 10’s 6.3-inch Actua display with 3,000-nit peak brightness is sharp and vibrant, with better readability outdoors.⁴ And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

A battery that lasts. And charges fast: Pixel 10 has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

True-to-life images. Out-of-this-world editing: Pixel 10 has an upgraded advanced triple camera system, with a new 5x telephoto lens and Super Res Zoom up to 20x. So it’s easy to capture stunning photos and videos in almost any light, and make complex edits with a few taps.
Step up your selfies: Take sharp, clear, share-worthy selfies with the 10.5 MP camera and autofocus.⁵ And when you want to fit more in, the 95° field of view makes it a snap.⁶

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

Group pics the whole group loves: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.

Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

Low light? No problem.: Capture the night with crystal-clear, bright pics and videos, no matter the lighting with Night Mode.
Bring out the beauty with every pic: Put all your favorite details on display. Portrait Mode auto- detects and adjusts to what you want front and center, making all your photos worthy of a frame.
Resolution that wows: From elaborate landscapes to intricate creations, capture vivid detail with 50MP resolution.
Smooth. Bright. Epic.: Your favorite content will look even more epic on a bright display with Vision Booster.

Color that adapts to your day: Streaming on the go, working from your patio or binge-watching late into the night? The Galaxy S22 adaptive screen automatically optimizes color and brightness, outdoors and indoors.
A battery that keeps your day going: Power every scroll, click, tap and stream all day long² with an intelligent battery that works with you, not against you.
Super-fast charging that won’t hold you back: Dive back into action at a moment’s notice with 25W Super-Fast Charging.⁴
A new standard of premium: Expertly engineered to outlast your day with class. Finally, a phone that meets your standards.
Don’t just stream it. Share it.: Watch viral YouTube videos and content together with your friends, from anywhere.
Get up close from afar: Your view just got an upgrade. 30x Space Zoom lets you get a VIP look from any seat.
Snap a ton with just one take: Snap perfect, profile-worthy photos and viral videos at the same time in one click.⁵
Multi-cam recording activated: Slide into the director’s chair and create share-ready videos on the spot with multi-cam recording and automatic pro-style effects.
Save your heart out: Need space? Galaxy S22 got you. Save all of your selfies, ridiculous vids, latest podcasts, app updates and more with 128GB and 256GB options.
Processing speed that keeps up with you: Snap, switch, stream and surf with the speed of our fastest processor ever.
Serious security: Use your phone with confidence — Galaxy S22 helps keep your private data protected with multilayered security.⁶
Phone and PC, beautifully in sync: Link to Windows gives you the power to sync your phone with your PC, so you can work from your phone without even picking it up.⁷
Powerful apart. Stronger together.: Get more out of the activities you love the most when you connect Galaxy S22 with Galaxy Buds and Galaxy Watch.⁸

products.page_description: Just the right amount of everything. A new dual‑camera system captures more of what you see and love. An all‑day battery life lets you do more and charge less. And high‑quality video, so your memories look better than ever. It just got a whole lot harder to take a bad photo. All‑new dual‑camera system. Take your photos from wide to ultra wide. A redesigned interface uses the new Ultra Wide camera to show you what’s happening outside the frame — and lets you capture it. Shoot and edit videos as easily as you do photos. It’s the world’s most popular camera, now with a whole new perspective. Shoot and edit high-quality video in a smartphone. iPhone 11 shoots beautifully sharp 4K video at 60 fps across all its cameras. The Ultra Wide camera captures four times more scene, so it’s perfect for action shots like your dog catching a frisbee. PRIVACY— A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

features: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks². And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BREAKTHROUGH BATTERY LIFE—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 33 hours of video playback.⁴ Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.⁵

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 Pro activates with an eSIM. With eSIM¹², you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY—A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

The new USB‑C connector lets you charge your Mac or iPad with the same cable you use to charge iPhone 15 Pro. Bye‑bye, cable clutter.

products.page_description: Mint Mobile is the easy way to save a ton on wireless. Get unlimited talk, text, and 5G data on the T-Mobile Network, and you can even bring your own phone. Genius, right? Our New Customer Offers allow new users to purchase 3 months at our lowest possible rate to get started. And did you know, once your 3-month plan ends, you can choose to renew with a 3-, 6- or 12-month plan… the more you buy, the more you save. You'll get the same intro plan savings by renewing for 12 months.
features: 3 months of unlimited Talk & Text: ​​Even your mom might ask you to stop calling so much.
Unlimited 5G • 4G LTE Data: Your service will switch seamlessly between 5G & 4G LTE, whichever signal is stronger. (May slow over 50GB during congestion)
5G coverage on the T-Mobile Network: Mint Mobile won't charge you for extra 5G. Check coverage in your area:
mintmobile.com/coverage (5G compatible device required)
20GB mobile hotspot per month: Use your data however you like, even where coffee shops don’t exist.
Free calling to Mexico, Canada and UK: Give your neighbors to the north, south, east or wherever a call, and enjoy our super-low international rates to over 160 countries worldwide.
Free Wi-Fi calling: Perfect for when you're in an underground world with bad reception, but excellent Wi-Fi.

Mint Mobile is here to help:: If you're having issues with activating your SIM or received an expired card contact Mint's Care Team and they will make it right for you. Call 800-683-7392 or chat with us online or in-app.

products.page_description: Samsung Galaxy S26+ is designed for the moments when creativity strikes — and the pace of your day doesn’t slow down. Powered by Galaxy AI, it helps you shape ideas, express yourself and keep everything moving naturally from inspiration to execution. With Photo Assist, creativity goes far beyond the original shot. Add or remove elements while restoring details or apply artistic styles like painting, black-and-white or playful illustrations to reimagine your photos in seconds. It’s an easy, intuitive way to give your images a new perspective — no additional apps required. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI takes those ideas even further. Create custom stickers, personalized profile pictures or entirely new images with a simple prompt. Whether you’re refining a memory or starting from scratch, Galaxy S26+ makes it effortless to turn imagination into something tangible and ready to share. As ideas turn into action, Galaxy S26+ keeps everything in sync. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI supports your conversations by surfacing helpful actions like adding events, viewing your calendar, sharing photos, browsing locations or sending contact details — right when they make sense. And with ProScaler enhancing sharpness and color automatically, everything you create, read and type looks clearer and more vibrant throughout the day. Samsung Galaxy S26+ brings creativity and momentum together — helping you express more, organize faster and move through your day with ease.
features: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.
Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26+ and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

products.full_description: Pricing: One-time price: $1199.99 (regular $1299.99); Monthly payment: $50.00 for 24 months via Best Buy financing Samsung Galaxy S26+ is designed for the moments when creativity strikes — and the pace of your day doesn’t slow down. Powered by Galaxy AI, it helps you shape ideas, express yourself and keep everything moving naturally from inspiration to execution. With Photo Assist, creativity goes far beyond the original shot. Add or remove elements while restoring details or apply artistic styles like painting, black-and-white or playful illustrations to reimagine your photos in seconds. It’s an easy, intuitive way to give your images a new perspective — no additional apps required. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI takes those ideas even further. Create custom stickers, personalized profile pictures or entirely new images with a simple prompt. Whether you’re refining a memory or starting from scratch, Galaxy S26+ makes it effortless to turn imagination into something tangible and ready to share. As ideas turn into action, Galaxy S26+ keeps everything in sync. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI supports your conversations by surfacing helpful actions like adding events, viewing your calendar, sharing photos, browsing locations or sending contact details — right when they make sense. And with ProScaler enhancing sharpness and color automatically, everything you create, read and type looks clearer and more vibrant throughout the day. Samsung Galaxy S26+ brings creativity and momentum together — helping you express more, organize faster and move through your day with ease. Features: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.; Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.; Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.; Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.; Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³; Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.; Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.; Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.; Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26+ and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.; A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today. products.page_description: iPhone 16 Pro Max features a Grade 5 titanium design with a new, refined microblasted texture. Titanium has one of the highest strength-to-weight ratios of any metal, making these models incredibly strong and impressively light. iPhone 16 Pro Max comes in four stunning finishes. Internal design improvements — including a 100 percent recycled aluminum thermal substructure and back glass optimizations that further dissipate heat — enable up to 20 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 15 Pro Max. New display technology allows us to route display data under active pixels with no distortion, resulting in thinner borders for larger 6.3-inch and 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR displays that feel great in your hand. iPhone 16 Pro Max is splash, water, and dust resistant. It also has our latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s two times tougher than any smartphone glass. iPhone 16 Pro Max is built for Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple. iPhone 16 Pro Max takes video capture to a whole new level with 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision. Enabled by the new 48MP Fusion camera with second-generation quad-pixel sensor and our powerful A18 Pro chip, iPhone 16 Pro Max lets you record 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision in video mode or slo-mo. A phenomenally powerful chip, A18 Pro enables Apple Intelligence with a faster Neural Engine, an improved CPU and GPU, and a big jump in memory bandwidth. It also drives advanced video and photo features like Camera Control, and it delivers our best-ever graphics performance for AAA gaming.

products.description: iPhone 17 Pro. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.3-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and breakthrough battery life.
products.page_description: iPhone 17 Pro. The most powerful iPhone ever. Brilliant 6.3-inch display, aluminum unibody design, A19 Pro chip, all 48MP rear cameras, and breakthrough battery life.
features: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks². And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BREAKTHROUGH BATTERY LIFE—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 33 hours of video playback.⁴ Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.⁵

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7¹⁰, 5G networks¹¹, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹²

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 Pro activates with an eSIM. With eSIM¹², you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY—A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

products.page_description: iPhone 16 Plus. Built for Apple Intelligence. Featuring Camera Control. 48MP Fusion camera. Five vibrant colors. And A18 chip.
features: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.¹ With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data.
TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL—Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.

GET FURTHER AND CLOSER—The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you takes incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES—The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles anytime you want.

SUPERSMART A18 CHIP—A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

LONGER BATTERY LIFE—iPhone 16 Plus works together with the A18 chip to deliver a big boost in battery life with up to 27 hours video playback.² Charge via USB-C or snap on a MagSafe charger for faster wireless charging.³

DESIGNED TO LAST—iPhone 16 Plus has a sturdy, aerospace-grade aluminum design with a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR display.⁴ It’s remarkably durable with the latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s 2x tougher than any smartphone glass.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR IPHONE—With iOS 18 you can tint your Home Screen icons with any color. Find your favorite shots faster in the redesigned Photos app. And add playful, animated effects to any word, phrase, or emoji in iMessage.⁵

SATELLITE CONNECTIVITY—If you don't have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁶ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can't.⁷

features: UNIBODY DESIGN. FOR EXCEPTIONAL POWER.—Heat-forged aluminum unibody design for the most powerful iPhone ever made.

DURABLE CERAMIC SHIELD. FRONT AND BACK.—Ceramic Shield protects the back of iPhone 17 Pro Max, making it 4x more resistant to cracks.² And the new Ceramic Shield 2 on the front has 3x better scratch resistance.³
THE ULTIMATE PRO CAMERA SYSTEM—With all 48MP rear cameras and 8x optical-quality zoom—the widest zoom range ever in an iPhone. It’s the equivalent of 8 pro lenses in your pocket.
18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA— Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.
A19 PRO CHIP. VAPOR COOLED. LIGHTNING FAST.—A19 Pro is the most powerful iPhone chip yet, delivering up to 40 percent better sustained performance.
BEST BATTERY LIFE IN AN IPHONE EVER—The unibody design creates massive additional battery capacity, for up to 39 hours of video playback.#&8308; Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.#&8309;

iOS 26. NEW LOOK. EVEN MORE MAGIC.—A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful, and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customizable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening, and more.⁶
BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE—Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly.⁷

SATELLITE FEATURES—If you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, iPhone can connect to a satellite so you can send and receive messages and Tapbacks.⁸ In a severe car crash, iPhone can connect to emergency services when you can’t.⁹
STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS.—Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7¹⁰, 5G networks¹¹, and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.¹²

eSIM, FLEXIBLE. SECURE. SEAMLESS.—iPhone 17 Pro Max activates with an eSIM¹². With eSIM, you enjoy greater flexibility, enhanced convenience, increased security, and seamless connectivity, especially when traveling internationally.
PRIVACY— A whole new level of privacy and security. Built in.

products.title: Apple - Pre-Owned Excellent iPhone 16 Pro 5G 128GB - Apple Intelligence - (Unlocked) - Black Titanium
products.description: iPhone 16 Pro features a Grade 5 titanium design with a new, refined microblasted texture. Titanium has one of the highest strength-to-weight ratios of any metal, making these models incredibly strong and impressively light. iPhone 16 Pro comes in four stunning finishes. Internal design improvements — including a 100 percent recycled aluminum thermal substructure and back glass optimizations that further dissipate heat — enable up to 20 percent better sustained performance than iPhone 15 Pro. So you can do all the things you love — like high-intensity gaming — for longer. New display technology allows us to route display data under active pixels with no distortion, resulting in thinner borders for larger 6.3-inch and 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR displays that feel great in your hand. iPhone 16 Pro is splash, water, and dust resistant. It also has our latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s two times tougher than any smartphone glass. Talk about durable. iPhone 16 Pro is built for Apple Intelligence, the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself, and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no one else can access your data — not even Apple. iPhone 16 Pro takes video capture to a whole new level with 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision — our highest resolution and frame rate combo yet. Enabled by the new 48MP Fusion camera with second-generation quad-pixel sensor and our powerful A18 Pro chip, iPhone 16 Pro lets you record 4K 120 fps Dolby Vision in video mode or slo-mo. A phenomenally powerful chip, A18 Pro enables Apple Intelligence with a faster Neural Engine, an improved CPU and GPU, and a big jump in memory bandwidth. It also drives advanced video and photo features like Camera Control, and it delivers our best-ever graphics performance for AAA gaming.

products.page_description: Your life is dynamic, so your phone should be too. Galaxy Z Flip7 moves with you, flexing to whatever your day throws your way. It opens to an expanded 6.9" screen that delivers a more comfortable user experience, then folds down small enough to fit in your palm, pocket or purse. And all that flexibility comes without compromise. The 50MP high res camera captures crisp shots day or night, while FlexCam lets you shoot hands free from almost any angle. On the cover, the larger FlexWindow lets you quickly access smart tools like Now Brief, while the new MultiStar integration makes it easier than ever to add your favorite widgets to your front screen. Plus, FlexWindow is fully customizable, allowing you to create your own screen or select from a variety of fun designs that help you make your phone feel more you. You can even switch playlists or talk to Google Gemini to get assistance on the fly all without opening your Flip. With its convenient and pocketable design, this phone transforms in to what you need when you need it. Galaxy Z Flip7- the phone that flexes with you.
features: Flip into full-day battery power: The battery life you need, packed into the foldable you want. Galaxy Z Flip7 features the biggest battery on a Z Flip that lasts through busy schedules, long shoots and late-night scrolls.¹ The battery on Galaxy Z Flip7 was made for those unpredictable days so you can do more, charge less and still finish the day with power to spare.

Flex it and free your hands: Go hands-free when you stream, video call or take pics on Galaxy Z Flip7. With FlexMode, Galaxy Z Flip7 stays open at just the right angle, giving you the perfect view of recipes, timers, content or anything else on your screen.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy Z Flip7. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of Tap to Pay² with the peace of mind knowing your purchase is secured by Samsung Knox technology.

Galaxy Z Flip7 helps you free up more time to do the things you love by handling multiple tasks with one simple command.⁵

Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.⁷

With Galaxy Z Flip7, you can ensure the group looks their best.⁹ Use Best Face with Galaxy AI⁸ to find everyone’s most flattering face, and then combine them into one stunning photo worth sharing.

Simply describe the pic to your Galaxy Z Flip7 device and it finds it for you in seconds. Gone are the days of endlessly scrolling through your Gallery,¹¹ giving you more time to compose the perfect throwback post.

products.page_description: When everything just works, you stay in the moment. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra anticipates what you need next, empowers your creativity, delivers powerful performance with stunning, ultra-vivid viewing and even gives you the freedom to keep your screen private—whenever you choose. Out with friends and capturing the night? Nightography brings every scene to life, revealing rich detail even in low light. Snap photos or record video confidently as the night goes on, and then use Photo Assist with Galaxy AI to refine your shots in seconds —cleaning up distractions, enhancing details and helping every memory look the way it felt. No extra apps. No slowing down. Creativity doesn’t stop once the moment is captured. Creative Studio with Galaxy AI on Galaxy S26 Ultra turns inspiration into creation, just like that. Transform photos into custom stickers, design invitations or generate entirely new images using a simple prompt —all without switching apps or learning new tools. Whether you’re refining a memory or imagining something brand new, Galaxy AI helps bring ideas to life effortlessly, so creativity feels intuitive, not technical. When it’s time to turn ideas into plans, Galaxy S26 Ultra makes it simple. Now Nudge with Galaxy AI helps you stay on top of conversations by suggesting quick actions like adding an event, sharing a photo or finding a location —all without slowing things down. All of this happens with privacy in mind. With the world’s first privacy display built into a phone, you can keep personal moments for your eyes only. Whether you’re creating, checking emails or just catching up, everything feels effortless and on your terms. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra is more than a smartphone —it’s your companion.
features: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Clear when you look at it straight on but more private when others look in, Privacy Display can even be preset to automatically turn on when receiving notifications, typing in passwords or using specific apps.¹³

Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Play graphic-intensive games with lightning-fast responsiveness and top the leaderboard with Galaxy S26 Series.

Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.

Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³

Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.

Memorable nights, clearly captured: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. When you take photos or record videos, S26 automatically adjusts in real time to keep what you capture clear and bright so you never have to think about lighting or settings.

Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.
Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

Charge fast. Move faster.: Life doesn’t wait for an outlet. Galaxy S26 Ultra is Super Fast Charging 3.0 ready —helping you spend less time plugged in and more time capturing, scrolling and streaming without missing a moment.¹⁴

Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

Galaxy S26+ and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.; A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today. products.page_description: Imagine a new phone that truly simplifies your day. Galaxy S25 does more than keep your world all in one place —it uses AI to intuitively streamline your life. What if you could plan a night out with your friends with one simple ask? Your personal assistant will find the perfect spot and text it to them. Want to keep tabs on your busy day ahead? Galaxy S25 gives you the insights you need before you know you need them with Now Brief. Want to wow with your content? Capture and curate post-worthy shots every time with an incredible high-res camera. Looking for a phone that can truly keep up with you? Galaxy S25 is built with a long-lasting battery. What if you could experience epic tech that brings ease to your everyday? Galaxy S25 does just that.
features: Multiple tasks with one ask: Discover a new world of convenience with a personal assistant that can do more than ever before. Have it Google search for a pet-friendly vegan restaurant nearby and text it to your friend.
Ask it to find your favorite team’s game schedule and put it on your calendar. Free up more time to do the things you love with a phone that handles multiple tasks with one simple command.¹

Insights that keep you a step ahead: Stay one step ahead with a phone that gives you the info you need before you even know you need it. Galaxy S25 gives you personalized insights based on your schedule. For example, if it’s going to rain, your phone will remind you to grab an umbrella before heading out.²

Reduce the noise. Reveal the magic: With Galaxy S25, you can capture wow-worthy videos, even in dark or noisy environments. Use Night Video to capture your evening out with friends in vivid detail. Then minimize unwanted sounds, like the noisy person next to you, so you can relive your favorite moments with fewer distractions.³

Bring out the best in every face: Capture every portrait with clarity and confidence on Galaxy S25. The advanced portrait features adjust skin tones and preserve natural textures, giving every shot a polished, professional look.
More power to you: The upgraded processor on Galaxy S25 handles complex AI features effortlessly.

The display your content deserves: Galaxy S25 helps you get your head in the game with lifelike details on an incredible display. Watch the worlds of your favorite games come to life with intricate reflections, realistic shadows and vivid lighting effects.⁴

One simple number. A world of insights.: Start your day in the know using Energy Score with Galaxy AI. It’s a daily score based off yesterday’s sleep, activity and heart rate, all collected by your Galaxy Ring or Watch. Then go deeper and discover insights for how to improve it on your Galaxy S25 device.⁵

Track your sleep from your wrist to your phone: Get an edge on your competition when you learn better sleep habits with the help of Galaxy AI. Track your sleep with your Galaxy Watch Ultra, and then get in-depth personalized tips on your Galaxy S25 device to put you on a path to feeling well rested.⁵
Stay up to date while your screen stays locked: Stay in the know on the go with Now Bar. It provides really quick updates, right on the lock screen of your Galaxy S25 device.

Customize what you want to see —from your team’s latest score on Google Sports to your Energy Score on Samsung Health —then see it at a glance on your Now Bar. It even seamlessly connects with the all-new Now Brief so you can conveniently get helpful tips throughout your day.⁶

Stay charged. And in charge.: Take charge of your day with Galaxy S25. Built with long-lasting batteries, these phones optimize energy use so you can stream your favorite shows, navigate a new city and video call your friends and family for hours without having to worry about recharging.⁷ Also, charge your phone from 0% to 50% in just 30 minutes.⁹

Boost your gameplay with a boss-level battery: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy S25 is the ultimate boost for on-the-go gaming. It’s engineered to use energy efficiently so you can complete entire quests, compete in rounds of online tournaments and run circles around your rivals without worrying about your phone running on empty.
A shortcut to your favorite AI tools: With AI Select on Galaxy S25, you’ve got easy access to powerful tools that help you do more with just about anything you see on your screen.

Say you’ve found a piece of text or an image you like, take a screenshot and then access AI Select. Your phone uses AI to analyze your selection and then offers you a variety of tools you can use to take that piece of content even further.
Switching is quick and easy: With Smart Switch, you can move your pics, videos, music, apps, contacts and convos to their new home, safely and securely, in just a few simple steps.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S25. Easily access compatible payment cards and memberships from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of tap to pay with the peace of mind your purchase is secured by Samsung’s Knox technology.⁸

And with a screen this vibrant, you can go beyond just watching your favorite videos and socials to feeling like you’re a part of them.

feature_entries.title: Group selfies made easy
feature_entries.description: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

feature_entries.title: Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.
feature_entries.description: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

feature_entries.title: A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy
feature_entries.description: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

And when you want to do more, Creative Studio makes it simple to create custom stickers, personalize profile pictures or generate new images from a quick prompt. No extra apps. No technical skills. Just effortless tools that help turn ideas into something uniquely yours. Samsung Galaxy S26 brings performance, immersion and creativity together — designed to keep everything you do feeling fast, vivid and inspired. Features: Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.; Strong performance. Smooth play: Push the boundaries of what’s possible in mobile gaming, thanks to our most powerful processor yet. Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.; Want to add in a few plates or cups to elevate the scene? Pull objects from Samsung Gallery, and they’ll naturally blend in with the scene’s lighting and shadows. You can even apply AI-generated styles to give your photo a totally different vibe.; Make it. Edit it. Share it.: Meet your new creative outlet. From playful illustrations to 3D cartoons, add fun to your everyday moments —whether it’s a custom wallpaper, stickers for your group chat, a special contact photo or an invitation.⁴ ³; Smart suggestions. Brilliant timing.: Now Nudge with Galaxy AI³ is your behind-the-scenes assistant that just gets you. When you need to reply¹ to a text, search for info or fill out an online form, Now Nudge uses your screen cues to pull up information⁵ saved on your phone, right when you need it. That means quicker replies, fewer frantic app switches and more moments that feel like you’re running your day —and not the other way around.; Richer color. Sharper wins.: Discover the immensely immersive display on Galaxy S26. With a screen that automatically enriches colors, you can catch all the little things you’ve been missing. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.; A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today. products.page_description: Unbeatable value with a slim, durable design and all the essential features you need await on Galaxy A36 5G. With more storage, you can keep your favorite photos, apps and memories without worrying about running out of space. Capture stunning studio grade selfies with the enhanced front camera and easily polish them with AI photo editing tools. The large 6.7" display makes gaming, scrolling and movie nights more enjoyable than ever. Enjoy all the awesome perks that come with an A Series phone, including Samsung TV Plus and partner offers like three months of free Peacock Premium. Plus, the redesigned One UI 7 interface offers smoother navigation and personalized design, giving you effortless access to the features you love most. Whether you're staying connected, capturing moments or browsing, A36 5G gives you premium performance at an affordable price. It's the smart choice you’ve been waiting for. Awesome price. Amazing value.
features: Awesome price. Amazing value.: Galaxy A36 5G provides performance, design and premium features at a price you'll love. Enjoy crisp details with a triple lens camera and edit them easily with new AI photo editing tools. Plus, A36 5G includes Samsung Wallet¹ and six years of OS and security updates so that your phone stays secure and up to date.

Enjoy all things awesome: With Galaxy A Series, you're not just getting a great phone, you're unlocking incredible value. Enjoy Awesome Perks like three months of free Peacock Premium,² all while enjoying top tier features at an unbeatable price.

The best of TV. All for free. All on your phone.: Your Galaxy A Series device comes with Samsung TV Plus- all the entertainment you want at zero cost. Choose from 350+ live TV channels and thousands of movies and shows on demand, all for free.

Awesome screen for everything: Elevate your content no matter where you are with the 6.7 display³ of Galaxy A36 5G. Enjoy massive detail and stunning clarity whether you're gaming, streaming or browsing. With Vision Booster, your screen shines brighter than ever, now reaching 1200 nits, ensuring vivid colors and sharp images even in bright environments. This adaptable screen makes it easy to take your entertainment on the go, delivering an immersive experience that’s perfect for any setting.

Amazing quality, effortlessly captured: From family photos to dinner with friends, Galaxy A36 5G enhanced front facing camera makes every selfie look like it came straight from a photo shoot. Now with an upgraded front camera, you can snap studio grade selfies in a snap.

With high definition video and optical image stabilization, your photos and content will be clear, crisp and blur free, every time. Take it to the next level with incredible new AI photo editing tools that allow you to tweak and enhance all of your favorite memories.

See family moments in a whole new light: Your family’s special moments just got brighter with Galaxy A36 5G. With effortless Nightography, you can capture clear high quality photos and videos automatically without adjusting manual settings. Whether it's a spontaneous gathering or those unscripted moments that happen anytime, Nightography ensures you’ll never miss the shot, even in low light. Let Galaxy A36 5G do the work so you can focus on enjoying the moment.

Awesome battery. Amazing charge.: Whether it’s family moments or important calls, stay powered without the wait with Galaxy A36 5G. Plus, Super Fast Charging⁴ ensures you're back up and running as quickly as possible so you can stay connected without being tied to an outlet.
Awesome performance. Amazing speed.: Play to the fullest and set your graphics to high on your favorite games with our most powerful Galaxy A Series processor yet.⁵
Awesomely fast 5G: Ready to speed things up? Load games, browse the web and download content fast with 5G⁶ available on all Galaxy A Series devices.

Unmatched experience: Explore a revamped interface design with One UI 7, offering enhanced visuals for a seamless Galaxy A Series experience. The redesigned user interface elevates your everyday use, whether you're customizing your home screen with personalized widgets, quickly accessing your favorite apps or enjoying smoother transitions between tasks. With One UI 7, everything feels intuitive and tailored to your needs.

Personal data stays personal: Enjoy greater peace of mind with enhanced personalization. Knox Vault ⁷ not only secures your passwords, biometrics and encryption keys in a tamper proof isolated environment but also protects against hardware attacks. When an external threat is detected, Knox Vault triggers an alarm and blocks unauthorized access, keeping your data safe at the deepest level.

Six years of updates. Awesome security.: Galaxy A36 5G is built to last with six years of OS and security updates,⁸ keeping it protected, efficient and always up to date. That means you get more mileage out of your phone without missing a beat. Stay ahead with reliable performance, long term peace of mind and a smart investment that goes further for you.

Awesomely durable. Awesomely dependable.: Experience amazing durability and value with the water --, dirt and dust resistant Galaxy A36 5G. Power through your day with unstoppable confidence knowing this ultra durable and reliable device has your back. With an exceptional IP67⁹ rating, it’s built to withstand the elements, keeping up with your toughest challenges whether you're out exploring or tackling the daily grind.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy A Series phone. Easily access compatible payment cards and membership cards from the convenience of your phone. Plus, enjoy the ease of Tap to Pay¹⁰ with the peace of mind that your purchase is secured by Samsung Knox technology.

Now there’s even more in store: Enjoy big storage for big memories. Easily store your photos, videos and important files on your Galaxy A36 5G. With up to 128GB¹¹ of internal storage, A36 5G keeps all your memories close without you worrying about running low on space.

Circle it, search it, find it. Just like that.: What’s your favorite influencer wearing? Where’d they go on vacation? What’s that word mean? Don’t try to describe it use Circle to Search with Google¹² and get the answer in a snap. With Galaxy A36 5G, simply circle it on your screen to learn more.

Awesome photos. Effortless edits: Effortlessly enhance your family photos with intuitive editing tools at your fingertips. With My Filter, you can save and adjust your favorite edits to maintain a consistent look across your pictures. Need to fix a distracting element? Easily remove unwanted objects and your Galaxy phone will seamlessly fill in the background. Plus, with AI powered suggestions, you can refine your photos with ease, ensuring every moment is captured just the way you remember it.
Slim. Sleek. Modern: Confidently take on your day with the slimmer design of Galaxy A36 5G, complete with a simple yet classy finish.

Stay on topic with tech that stays connected: Always answer the call with Galaxy A Series and your Buds. E ven if you’re on your PC, Tab or Samsung TV, your Buds 1 sense your phone ringing so you can answer with a tap.
A Series ly fast way to share content: Need to share content on the fly? Easily send big files from your Galaxy A Series phone with impressive quality to any iOS or Android device with Quick Share.
Awesome video calling made easy: Easily video call family and friends with Google Meet on Galaxy A Series.
Check off your health goals with Galaxy A Series: Check off your health, sleep and workout goals with Galaxy A Series and Samsung Health.
Your phone. Your PC. Perfectly in sync: Pair your Galaxy A Series phone with your Windows PC to easily sync photos, manage notifications and respond to calls and messages with Link to Windows.

products.page_description: Meet Pixel 10 Pro, the new standard for pro phones. Advanced AI with Gemini, unbelievable camera quality, impeccable design, and the next-gen Google Tensor G5 chip.¹
features: Universal Unlocked: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁸ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁹

You show, Gemini tells: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.⁰ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.⁰

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.⁶
16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

The brightest display ever on a Pixel: See your phone in a whole new light with 3,300-nit peak brightness.⁴ The new Super Actua display makes your screen look immersive and vibrant, even in direct sunlight. And it has a refresh rate up to 120Hz for super smooth scrolling and switching between apps.

Fast-charging, all-day battery: Pixel 10 Pro XL has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

Studio-quality photos. Pro-level videos: Pixel’s pro camera system makes everything look amazing by default, even in low light. Capture more of the scene with advanced AI models, and bring out incredible details with up to 100x zoom, stunning 50 MP images, and super steady videos in 8K with Video Boost.⁵

Amazing selfies of you, and everyone else: The 42 MP front camera with autofocus features a 103° field of view – Pixel’s widest, most selfie-ready yet.⁵ You and the whole group come out remarkably sharp in photos or videos, even in dimly lit situations like restaurants and concerts.

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

Snap your best pics with the help of Gemini: Camera Coach uses Gemini models to read the scene, offer you suggestions, and help you find the best angle and lighting. It can even suggest the best modes for you to use.⁷

Group pics the whole group loves: With Pixel, it’s a snap to take shareable group pics. After you take the photo, Pixel can automatically find and combine similar photos into one where everyone looks their best.
Up to 20x the video zoom power: Pixel 10 Pro combines a powerful telephoto lens for up to 20x zoom with Super Res Zoom Video and advanced processing to give you smooth, high-quality video.
Low-light videos get a glow-up: Night Sight Video with Video Boost brings out the highest-quality 8K recordings on a Pixel for even richer scenes of sunset skylines and candlelit dinners.

Bring all your stuff. Even your passwords: Move contacts, photos, iMessages, and more without losing a thing. It only takes about 20 minutes.¹¹,¹² And if you use Google Password Manager, you can access your passwords once you sign in.

Night mode senses when light is low and kicks in automatically, maintaining clarity while capturing beautiful vibrant color. All you have to do is start snapping. Deep Fusion, in mid to low light, analyzes multiple exposures to maximize detail. Check out the texture in the wood, fabric, and crystal. And the Ultra Wide gets you a heroic perspective. Smart HDR 3 balances the elements in a shot, bringing out detail in the subject and trees while retaining the rich color of the sky — even at high noon. Beyond faces, Smart HDR 3 uses machine learning to recognize scenes, then adjusts sharpness, color, and white balance where needed. Even in bright light, Smart HDR 3 is amazing at capturing texture, skin tone, color saturation, and individual details that make photos feel TRUE to life. Portrait mode artfully blurs the background to put all the focus on your subject. Then there’s Night mode Time-lapse. Just prop up your iPhone and let the light trails begin. Now you can record 4K HDR video with Dolby Vision; edit in Photos or iMovie. Then zap it to your TV using AirPlay to see all that color and detail. It’s a start-to-finish cinematic experience. iOS 14 is packed with shortcuts that get you just what you want, right when you want it. iPhone is designed to protect your information. Face ID data doesn’t leave your iPhone and is never backed up to iCloud or anywhere else. iOS shows you an app’s privacy practices before you download it. When you use Apple Pay, your card number isn’t shared with merchants. And the list goes on. To charge your new iPhone, you can continue to use your USB‑A to Lightning cable. products.page_description: iPhone 15 Plus brings you Dynamic Island, a 48MP Main camera, and USB-C—all in a durable color-infused glass and aluminum design.
features: DYNAMIC ISLAND COMES TO IPHONE 15 — Dynamic Island bubbles up alerts and Live Activities — so you don’t miss them while you’re doing something else. You can see who’s calling, track your next ride, check your flight status, and so much more.

INNOVATIVE DESIGN — iPhone 15 Plus features a durable color-infused glass and aluminum design. It’s splash, water, and dust resistant.¹ The Ceramic Shield front is tougher than any smartphone glass. And the 6.7" Super Retina XDR display² is up to 2x brighter in the sun compared to iPhone 14.

48MP MAIN CAMERA WITH 2X TELEPHOTO — The 48MP Main camera shoots in super high-resolution. So it’s easier than ever to take standout photos with amazing detail. The 2x optical-quality Telephoto lets you frame the perfect close-up.
NEXT-GENERATION PORTRAITS — Capture portraits with dramatically more detail and color. Just tap to shift the focus between subjects — even after you take the shot.

POWERHOUSE A16 BIONIC CHIP — The superfast chip powers advanced features like computational photography, fluid Dynamic Island transitions, and Voice Isolation for phone calls. And A16 Bionic is incredibly efficient to help deliver great all-day battery life.³
USB-C CONNECTIVITY — The USB-C connector lets you charge your Mac or iPad with the same cable you use to charge iPhone 15 Plus. You can even use iPhone 15 Plus to charge Apple Watch or AirPods.

VITAL SAFETY FEATURES — If your car breaks down when you’re off the grid, you can get help with Roadside Assistance via satellite.⁴ And if you need emergency services and you don’t have cell service or Wi-Fi, you can use Emergency SOS via satellite.⁴ With Crash Detection, iPhone can detect a severe car crash and call for help if you can’t.⁵

DESIGNED TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE — iPhone comes with privacy protections that help keep you in control of your data. It’s made from more recycled materials to minimize environmental impact. And it has built-in features that make iPhone more accessible to all.

COMES WITH APPLECARE WARRANTY — Every iPhone comes with a one-year limited warranty and up to 90 days of complimentary technical support. Get AppleCare+ or AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss to extend your coverage.

¹iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 15 Pro, and iPhone 15 Pro Max are splash, water, and dust resistant and were tested under controlled laboratory conditions with a rating of IP68 under IEC standard 60529 (maximum depth of 6 meters up to 30 minutes).

Splash, water, and dust resistance are not permanent conditions. Resistance might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge a wet iPhone; refer to the user guide for cleaning and drying instructions. Liquid damage not covered under warranty.

²The display has rounded corners. When measured as a standard rectangle, the screen is 6.12 inches (iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15) or 6.69 inches (iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 15 Plus) diagonally. Actual viewable area is less.
³Battery life varies by use and configuration; see apple.com/batteries for more information.

⁴Service is included for free for two years with the activation of any iPhone 15 model. Connection and response times vary based on location, site conditions, and other factors. See support.apple.com/kb/HT213885 for more information.
⁵iPhone 15 and iPhone 15 Pro can detect a severe car crash and call for help. Requires a cellular connection or Wi-Fi Calling.

products.description: Unfold extraordinary with Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold. Our largest screen, plus advanced AI with Gemini.¹ It’s the best Pixel for multitasking and entertainment.
products.page_description: Unfold extraordinary with Google Pixel 10 Pro Fold. Our largest screen, plus advanced AI with Gemini.¹ It’s the best Pixel for multitasking and entertainment.
features: Universal Unlocked: Compatible with all major U.S. carriers, including Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile. Also compatible with prepaid carriers including Cricket Wireless, MetroPCS, Google Fi, Total Wireless, Tracfone, Visible and Mint.

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: Google Tensor G5 is Pixel’s most powerful chip yet. It makes Pixel 10 phones even faster, bringing you Google’s most advanced AI, Pixel’s cutting-edge photo and video quality, and an all-day battery life.²,³

Do more than you think, more easily than you can imagine: Google AI on Pixel helps simplify your life and supercharge your creativity. Use it to brainstorm ideas,¹ create new images, better manage your screenshots, control multiple apps with one command,⁹ and get helpful info before you even have to ask.⁰

You show, Gemini tells: Share your camera in Gemini Live conversations to have a live back-and-forth chat with Gemini about what you’re seeing.¹¹ Show your living room to get help rearranging it. Show your pantry to get dinner ideas using those ingredients. Or show your wardrobe to get styling tips.

Picture yourself anywhere: Take your photos even further. Imagine yourself in different scenes, combine creative elements, make specific edits and more. It's easier than ever to bring your ideas to life.¹¹

Set your creative ideas in motion: Create a high-quality short video, complete with natural-sounding audio, simply by describing your idea. Or upload an image, explain the scene you want, and see your photo transform with motion and sound.¹²
16 GB of RAM for pro-level performance: Do more at once with Pixel 10 Pro Fold. It delivers our smoothest, fastest experiences in your most demanding apps and with Google’s most advanced AI.

Big and bright. Inside and out: Inside, you get a massive 8-inch Super Actua Flex display, ready to help you dive into immersive entertainment or find your flow with masterful multitasking.⁴ Outside, there’s a 6.4-inch Actua display that looks and feels great in your hand. And both screens are brighter than ever.⁴,⁵

Fast-charging, all-day battery: Pixel 10 Pro Fold has an all-day battery that can last over 24 hours, and up to 72 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ Plus, it has Pixelsnap magnetic technology for effortless wireless charging that snaps into place.

Tricky editing is effortless with the help of AI: It’s easy to work your editing magic with Pixel. Make complex edits, like removing distractions, moving objects, and merging photos into one where everyone looks their best.⁶
So many ways to selfie: With 10 MP selfie cameras on both the inner and outer screens, you’ll make a habit of snapping perfectly framed selfies.⁷ Love that for you.

Take the picture. And be in it, too: With Add Me, it’s even easier to make sure that no one’s left out of the photo. Now you can add the photographer to bigger groups and get more creative with the composition.

products.description: Do more than ever before with the game changing power of Galaxy AI on the expansive screen of Galaxy Z Fold6. Use Circle to Search with Google to find things fast now optimized for the oversized display so you can keep multiple windows open while you search. Get easy translations for face to face conversations using Interpreter with Galaxy AI in FlexMode, where you can see your language on one side of the screen and they can see theirs on the other. Plus, the large canvas is perfect for viewing in depth health tracking and insights from a paired Galaxy Watch or Galaxy Ring. Experience the extraordinary with Galaxy Z Fold6 the tablet like phone that lets you open up new possibilities with Galaxy AI .
